body_en: Atlantic Airways has placed a firm order with Airbus for two A320neo aircraft as the carrier pursues its ambition to build and all A320neo fleet.
On October 27, 2026, Airbus the purchase comes as Atlantic Airways , the national airline of the Faroe Islands, is looking to transition to a next-generation fleet.
Atlantic Airways currently operates a pair of A320-200s and two A320neos from Vágar Airport (VSE), the Faroe Islands’ only airport.
With this latest agreement, the carrier now has four A320neo aircraft on order, forming part of its long-term investment plan of up to DKK 2 billion ($298 million).
Atlantic Airways confirmed the two newly ordered A320neo aircraft are scheduled for delivery early next decade.

“Our ambition is to operate an exclusively A320neo aircraft fleet in the near future, and this agreement marks a significant step towards achieving that goal,” Niels Mortensen, Chairman of the Board of Atlantic Airways, said. “This investment will help ensure the continuous renewal of our fleet while supporting efficient operations.”
Atlantic Airways has previously stated in annual reports that it plans for all aircraft to be Airbus A320neo type by 2030.
The airline previously operated several Airbus A319-100s. The last was retired in 2022.

“We are pleased to strengthen our partnership with Atlantic Airways as they advance toward a complete A320neo fleet,” Benoît de Saint-Exupéry, Airbus EVP Sales of the Commercial Aircraft business, said. “By adding two additional latest generation A320neo aircraft to their future fleet, the airline is reinforcing its commitment to regional connectivity.”
He added: “We look forward to continuing our support to facilitate efficient connections for the Faroese communities.”

2026 年 10 月 27 日，空中客车公司进行此次收购之际，法罗群岛国家航空公司大西洋航空公司正在寻求向下一代机队转型。
大西洋航空公司目前在法罗群岛唯一的机场沃格机场 (VSE) 运营着两架 A320-200 和两架 A320neo。
根据这项最新协议，该航空公司现已订购了四架 A320neo 飞机，这是其高达 20 亿丹麦克朗（2.98 亿美元）的长期投资计划的一部分。
大西洋航空公司确认，两架新订购的 A320neo 飞机计划于下个十年初期交付。
大西洋航空公司董事会主席 Niels Mortensen 表示：“我们的目标是在不久的将来运营一支专门的 A320neo 机队，这项协议标志着实现这一目标的重要一步。” “这项投资将有助于确保我们机队的不断更新，同时支持高效运营。”
大西洋航空此前在年报中表示，计划到2030年所有飞机均为空客A320neo型。
该航空公司此前运营过几架空客 A319-100 飞机。最后一个已于 2022 年退役。
空客商用飞机业务销售执行副总裁伯努瓦·德·圣埃克苏佩里 (Benoît de Saint-Exupéry) 表示：“我们很高兴加强与大西洋航空公司的合作关系，因为他们正在向完整的 A320neo 机队迈进。” “通过在其未来机队中增加两架最新一代 A320neo 飞机，该航空公司正在加强其对区域互联互通的承诺。”
他补充道：“我们期待继续提供支持，以促进法罗群岛社区的高效联系。”

body_en: Air China launches Beijing–Keflavík service via Copenhagen - Aviation24.be
Air China launched scheduled flights between Beijing and Keflavík on 26 October, establishing the Icelandic airport’s first scheduled connection to mainland China.
The Airbus A330-300 service operates three times weekly with a stopover in Copenhagen, expanding Keflavík’s links with Asia and providing additional travel options between Iceland and China.

Airport operator Isavia said the route would support tourism and business links while helping diversify Keflavík’s network. Chief executive Sveinbjörn Indriðason described the launch as a milestone for Iceland’s international connectivity and an opportunity to strengthen trade and bilateral ties.

Passengers and crew on the inaugural flight were welcomed at Keflavík during an arrival ceremony. The announcement did not specify the aircraft type, operating days or whether tickets are available separately for the Copenhagen–Keflavík sector.

Breeze Airways is set to add more than 30 new routes across the United States and internationally as the airline continues to expand its reach and provide more nonstop flights between smaller markets. The airline's approach is to provide easy, low-cost flights between smaller cities and avoid large airport hubs .

Between October this year and through Summer 2027, Breeze is adding routes nationwide, with Myrtle Beach and Tampa leading with the most new services. Tampa is the airline's new number one airport . This article's data comes from Cirium , an online aviation analytics company.
Breeze Airways Adds 31 New Routes In Time For The Festive Season

Breeze is a low-cost carrier based in Utah ; however, its network stretches to either side of the country, with a select number of routes to Latin America and the Caribbean. Included in the new routes announced, the airline will begin serving three new services from Palm Beach (now named President Donald J. Trump International after the current US President who frequents the airport). These new services will operate from this December to Atlantic City, Columbus, and Greenville-Spartanburg.

In the New Year, new flights will begin in January from Charleston to Buffalo, Columbus to Punta Cana, plus Pittsburgh to Cancun and Punta Cana. Additional flights will be added from Richmond to Cancun and Fort Myers to Trenton.
Phoenix will see its New Orleans link with Breeze restored, now flying from February 1 to the Big Easy.

Myrtle Beach is the winner when it comes to the latest Breeze network expansion. From February through the beginning of July, 11 new routes will be added from the South Carolina beachside city, primarily serving the US East Coast.

The earliest route is from Myrtle Beach to Latrobe, which will begin on February 9. The majority of the new routes will begin in May, and the final current new route is to Buffalo, launching on July 1.

Myrtle Beach is a key market for Breeze, as it attempts to fill the void left by the collapse of Spirit Airlines . Spirit's dramatic exit from Myrtle Beach saw the passenger totals drop significantly, leaving the door wide open for another airline to step in.
Four New Routes From Raleigh-Durham, Six New Routes From Tampa

The airline hasn't stopped there, with an additional four new services set to begin from Raleigh-Durham between November and June. Destinations include Buffalo, Dayton, Las Vegas, and the Bahamas (Nassau).

Alaska Airlines is preparing to launch a new nonstop route between Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport (ANC) and Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT) on May 13, 2027, according to flight schedule information reported by aviation analyst Enilria. The seasonal service is scheduled to operate once daily using the Boeing 737 MAX 8 , with the flight expected to take approximately eight hours and 15 minutes, although the route remains subject to government approval. If launched as planned, the service would restore a nonstop connection between Anchorage and Tokyo after nearly three decades without the route.

The proposed addition is notable because it would see Alaska deploy a narrowbody aircraft on a lengthy transpacific journey, connecting Alaska's largest city directly with one of Japan's major international gateways. The planned service would run through September 7, 2027, targeting the summer travel season. However, questions remain about the aircraft's operational range, potential airspace restrictions, and the demand needed to sustain the route.

According to Enilria's report on Patreon , Alaska Airlines' proposed service will operate as flight AS21 from Anchorage to Tokyo Narita Airport , departing at 2:10 p.m. on May 13, 2027, and arriving at 3:25 p.m. the following day. The scheduled flight time is eight hours and 15 minutes, reflecting the time difference between Alaska and Japan. The return service, AS22, is scheduled to depart Narita at 9:45 p.m. on May 14 and arrive in Anchorage at noon the same day, with a published flight time of seven hours and 15 minutes.

The flights are listed as daily through September 7, 2027, with fares starting at $605. The planned aircraft would seat 161 passengers across two cabins: 16 First Class seats and 145 Main Cabin seats. The route would provide a direct alternative to connecting itineraries through other US gateways, potentially attracting leisure travelers and passengers visiting Japan from Alaska. Nevertheless, the schedules and fares should be treated as provisional until the airline confirms the service and the necessary government approvals are secured.
Can the Boeing 737 MAX 8 Handle Such a Long Route?

The proposed Anchorage–Tokyo service would push the Boeing 737 MAX 8 into a demanding long-haul assignment. According to Boeing's published specifications , the 737-8 has a maximum advertised range of 3,500 nautical miles (6,480 kilometers). The ANC-NRT route is about 3,426 miles (5,514 kilometers), although the airspace restrictions and potential deviations could increase the distance flown to more than 3,750 miles (6,035 kilometers). Actual operating capability depends on factors including payload, winds, fuel reserves, and the availability of suitable diversion airports.

The concern is not simply whether the aircraft can cover the scheduled distance under favorable conditions, but whether it can reliably complete the journey under the operational constraints of a transpacific flight. Extended-range operations over water require appropriate regulatory approvals, including compliance with extended-range twin-engine operations ( ETOPS ) requirements, as well as adequate contingency fuel and diversion planning. Enilria has specifically questioned the route's feasibility with the proposed aircraft, so the published schedule alone does not establish that the service is operationally viable.

However, precedents exist for operating the 737 MAX 8 on transpacific routes. United Airlines ' Guam-based narrowbody operation uses the aircraft to connect Guam with destinations across Asia and the western Pacific, including Tokyo, Manila, and Taipei. United also operates the aircraft on routes serving remote Pacific islands , although these missions do not necessarily match the proposed Anchorage–Tokyo flight's duration or range requirements. The comparison still shows how airlines can use modern narrowbodies to serve international markets over the Pacific that don't require widebody capacity.
Alaska Airlines Keeps Expanding Its International Network

The proposed Tokyo service would support Alaska Airlines' broader effort to expand its network and offer more nonstop connections. The carrier has been developing its international presence while continuing to serve domestic markets with its Boeing 737 fleet. Its broader growth strategy also includes long-haul services on widebody aircraft, giving the airline more options to match capacity to demand across its network.

Alaska has pursued additional nonstop routes to improve connectivity from its major hubs and regional markets. Anchorage could offer an alternative gateway for travelers heading to Asia, although the proposed Tokyo route's success would depend on attracting sufficient demand beyond the city's local population. Additional connecting flights into Anchorage could help support the service.

Northwest Airlines last served the Anchorage–Tokyo market nonstop in 1999, making the proposed launch a notable potential return after nearly 28 years. For now, the key question is whether Alaska can make the route work with the 737 MAX 8 while meeting all regulatory and operational requirements. If approved and launched, the seasonal service would offer a new direct link between Alaska and Japan, but its long-term prospects would depend on passenger demand and the aircraft's practical operating capabilities.

body_zh: 阿拉斯加航空将推出从安克雷奇飞往东京的 8 小时 737 MAX 8 航班
经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。

根据航空分析师 Enilria 报告的航班时刻表信息，阿拉斯加航空正准备于 2027 年 5 月 13 日开通泰德·史蒂文斯安克雷奇国际机场 (ANC) 和东京成田国际机场 (NRT) 之间的新直飞航线。该季节性航班计划每天使用波音 737 MAX 8 运营一次，预计飞行时间约为 8 小时 15 分钟，但该航线仍需获得政府批准。如果按计划启动，该服务将恢复安克雷奇和东京之间近三十年没有航线的不间断连接。
拟议的新增项目值得注意，因为阿拉斯加将在漫长的跨太平洋旅程中部署一架窄体飞机，将阿拉斯加最大的城市直接与日本主要国际门户之一连接起来。计划的服务将持续到 2027 年 9 月 7 日，针对夏季旅游旺季。然而，关于飞机的作战范围、潜在的空域限制以及维持航线所需的需求仍然存在问题。
根据 Enilria 在 Patreon 上的报道，阿拉斯加航空拟议的航班将由 AS21 航班运营，从安克雷奇飞往东京成田机场，于下午 2:10 起飞。 2027 年 5 月 13 日下午 3:25 抵达第二天。预定飞行时间为8小时15分钟，反映了阿拉斯加与日本之间的时差。返程航班 AS22 定于晚上 9:45 从成田机场出发。 5月14日中午抵达安克雷奇，公布飞行时间7小时15分钟。
这些航班截至 2027 年 9 月 7 日每天都有航班，票价起价为 605 美元。计划的飞机将在两个客舱中容纳 161 名乘客：16 个头等舱座位和 145 个经济舱座位。该航线将为通过其他美国门户转接行程提供直接替代方案，有可能吸引休闲游客和从阿拉斯加前往日本的乘客。尽管如此，在航空公司确认服务并获得必要的政府批准之前，时间表和票价应视为临时的。
波音 737 MAX 8 能否承担如此长的航线？
拟定的安克雷奇至东京航线将推动波音 737 MAX 8 承担艰巨的长途任务。根据波音公布的规格，737-8 的最大航程为 3,500 海里（6,480 公里）。 ANC-NRT 航线全长约 3,426 英里（5,514 公里），但空域限制和潜在偏差可能会将飞行距离增加到超过 3,750 英里（6,035 公里）。实际运行能力取决于有效载荷、风力、燃料储备以及合适改航机场的可用性等因素。
人们关心的不仅仅是飞机能否在有利条件下完成预定航程，而是在跨太平洋航班的运营限制下能否可靠地完成旅程。水上增程运行需要适当的监管批准，包括遵守增程双发运行 (ETOPS) 要求，以及充足的应急燃料和改航计划。 Enilria 特别质疑该航线使用拟议飞机的可行性，因此仅公布的时间表并不能证明该服务在运营上可行。
然而，在跨太平洋航线上运营 737 MAX 8 已有先例。联合航空在关岛的窄体机运营使用该飞机将关岛与亚洲和西太平洋的目的地连接起来，包括东京、马尼拉和台北。美联航还在服务偏远太平洋岛屿的航线上运营该飞机，尽管这些任务不一定符合拟议的安克雷奇-东京航班的持续时间或航程要求。比较仍然显示航空公司如何使用现代窄体飞机来服务不需要宽体运力的太平洋国际市场。
阿拉斯加航空不断扩大其国际网络
拟议的东京航线将支持阿拉斯加航空扩大其网络并提供更多直达航班的更广泛努力。该航空公司一直在发展其国际影响力，同时继续利用其波音 737 机队服务国内市场。其更广泛的增长战略还包括宽体飞机的长途服务，为该航空公司提供更多选择，以匹配整个网络的运力和需求。
阿拉斯加已寻求额外的直达航线，以改善其主要枢纽和区域市场的连通性。安克雷奇可以为前往亚洲的旅行者提供另一个门户，尽管拟议的东京航线的成功将取决于吸引该市当地人口以外的足够需求。飞往安克雷奇的额外转机航班可以帮助支持该服务。
西北航空上一次直飞安克雷奇至东京市场是在 1999 年，这使得拟议的推出在近 28 年后获得了显着的潜在回报。目前，关键问题是阿拉斯加能否让该航线与 737 MAX 8 一起运行，同时满足所有监管和运营要求。如果获得批准并启动，这一季节性航班将在阿拉斯加和日本之间提供一条新的直接航线，但其长期前景将取决于乘客需求和飞机的实际运营能力。

title_en: Pan Am's Past Revivals Ran 1996-1998, 1998-2004 & 2010-2014, But This One Is Still Waiting On The FAA
title_zh: 泛美航空过去曾于 1996 年至 1998 年、1998 年至 2004 年和 2010 年至 2014 年复兴，但这一次仍在等待美国联邦航空局 (FAA)
summary: Could we see the legendary Pan Am return to the skies soon?
summary_zh: 我们能很快看到传奇的泛美航空重返天空吗？
body_en: Pan Am's Past Revivals Ran 1996-1998, 1998-2004 & 2010-2014, But This One Is Still Waiting On The FAA

Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

The airline industry in the US today hardly looks anything like what it did 60 years ago. American, Delta, and United Airlines now operate massive long-haul networks, while many carriers have merged. Several notable airlines have also gone out of business, and one of the saddest liquidations came in 1991, when Pan American World Airways ceased operations. Pan Am was one of the most legendary carriers ever and the de facto flag carrier of the US, yet the industry left it behind.

But although Pan Am had been in decline for years and stopped operating altogether in 1991, the name didn't stay dead for long. The name returned in 1996, but this airline (also known as Pan Am II) merged with Carnival Airlines just two years later. The same happened to Pan Am III, founded in 1998 and out of business by 2004, as well as the fourth iteration, which operated from 2010 to 2014. Today, a new group of investors is betting that this time is the charm and is seeking FAA certification to relaunch Pan Am.

Although the Pan Am name has been revived several times, its reincarnations never resembled the massive international carrier that operated long-haul flights worldwide. In June 2025, the name briefly returned again for a series of charter flights paying tribute to the airline's golden days, but these were all-business class flights aboard Boeing 757s (an aircraft type Pan Am never operated), and they only operated for a short period of time.

However, during this time, Avi8 Air Capital began collaborating with Pan American Global Holdings, the owner of the Pan Am name rights, to evaluate the feasibility of fully reviving the Pan Am name again while running the charters. After developing a business plan, the new entity began seeking FAA certification in October 2025 to resume operations. It's seeking Part 121 certification, the FAA's strictest set of regulations for airlines operating large aircraft on scheduled services, such as passenger, cargo, or charter operations.

It's been announced that the new airline will be headquartered in Miami and will operate Airbus aircraft, with A220s or used A320s being preferred. CEO Ed Wegel also previously stated on LinkedIn in December 2025 that the airline intended to operate the Airbus A320neo " at some point in the future when the supply chain issues and engine issues are resolved ." In addition, the company has struck a deal with Amadeus to power its IT and distribution centers, with Avengers Flight Group for simulator training, and with Airbus for the manufacturer's SkyWise Digital Suite.

A380 747 787 A350 777 737 MAX A320neo More types

Part 121 governs scheduled carriers operating large transport aircraft, the strictest set of regulations for US air operators. This does not, however, mean that anyone can book a ticket with an airline, as it also governs companies operating charter flights like Atlas Air, Omni Air International, or the new Eastern Airlines. The regulations are not about the business model; they focus on the company's operations, the aircraft being flown, and the FAA oversight required to maintain safety.

The FAA will closely scrutinize Pan Am's operating procedures, manuals, maintenance programs, and more to ensure compliance with regulations. The regulator will verify that Pan Am's intended aircraft will be safely equipped while ensuring that the company is hiring appropriately qualified crew who will receive FAA-approved training. In addition, the FAA will review Pan Am's route planning, dispatch, and dangerous goods procedures, and Pan Am will need to submit thorough documentation for review.

Regulates scheduled commercial service with large aircraft; pilots must hold an ATPL, the most stringent operational and maintenance regulations
Regulates commercial on-demand charter and commuter service with low-capacity aircraft; pilots must hold a CPL, with less stringent operational and maintenance regulations than Part 121
Kalitta Charters, Wheels Up, Boutique Air, Counter Aviation

Much of the review process involves checking documentation, but the FAA will also be performing on-site checks and observations, while Pan Am will need to perform proving tests as well. This is not a quick or easy process, and certification can take several months or even years. For Pan Am, a new company with no revenue, this adds expense, and the longer Part 121 certification takes, the greater the financial pressure on the airline.

Despite using one of history's most famous airline names, the new Pan Am won't actually sell tickets on commercial flights. Rather, it'll be a charter airline mainly flying to Latin America, with scheduled passenger services coming later. Company leadership has stated previously that the airline will offer three classes of service while simultaneously planning to fly narrowbody aircraft. In all likelihood, this could mean economy and extra-legroom seats, along with a domestic first class cabin.

It's unconfirmed what aircraft the new Pan Am will/has acquired, but the Airbus A220 (presumably the A220-300) is the front-runner. However, new A220s are hard to get, and delays are common, so the company is also looking at used A320-200s as a backup, should it prove too difficult to get A220s in a timely fashion. It's unclear whether the A320neos are still part of the plan , but the airline aims to grow its narrowbody fleet while adding widebodies to the mix.

In the meantime, Pan Am is continuing its charter operations, as it's selling tickets for a 19-day all-inclusive excursion throughout Africa in June 2027. This will operate using a 757-200 configured with only business class seats, just like the 2025 charters. These flights are actually operated by Icelandair , meaning that they're not subject to the airline receiving FAA certification. What's more, the company is expanding to become more of a lifestyle brand than just an airline.

'A Journey To Reimagine Africa' is Pan Am's next high-end charter, but it won't be the last. The airline has established a 'Pan Am Journeys' subbrand for luxury private jet tours and has opened up bookings for a golf-themed trip to Ireland in September 2027 with the same 757 . The new Pan Am has also partnered with Holland America to charter the cruise ship ' Zuiderdam ' for a Caribbean tour that replicates routes operated by the original Pan Am flying boats, departing in October 2027.
body_zh: 泛美航空过去曾于 1996 年至 1998 年、1998 年至 2004 年和 2010 年至 2014 年复兴，但这一次仍在等待美国联邦航空局 (FAA)
Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
如今的美国航空业已与 60 年前截然不同。美国航空、达美航空和联合航空现在运营着庞大的长途网络，而许多航空公司已经合并。几家著名的航空公司也纷纷倒闭，最悲惨的清算之一发生在 1991 年，当时泛美世界航空公司停止运营。泛美航空公司是有史以来最具传奇色彩的航空公司之一，也是事实上的美国旗舰航空公司，但业界却将其抛在了后面。

尽管泛美航空多年来一直在衰落，并于 1991 年完全停止运营，但这个名字并没有消失太久。该名称于 1996 年回归，但这家航空公司（也称为 Pan Am II）仅在两年后就与嘉年华航空公司合并。同样的情况也发生在成立于 1998 年、于 2004 年停业的泛美航空 III 号以及于 2010 年至 2014 年运营的第四次迭代中。如今，一批新的投资者认为这一次是魅力所在，并正在寻求美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 认证以重新启动泛美航空。
尽管泛美航空这个名字已经多次复活，但它的重生从来都不像一家在全球范围内运营长途航班的大型国际航空公司。 2025 年 6 月，该名称再次短暂回归，推出了一系列包机航班，向该航空公司的黄金岁月致敬，但这些都是波音 757 飞机（泛美航空从未运营过的机型）的全商务舱航班，而且只运营了很短一段时间。
然而，在此期间，Avi8 Air Capital 开始与泛美航空公司名称权所有者泛美环球控股公司合作，评估在运营包机时再次全面恢复泛美航空公司名称的可行性。在制定业务计划后，新实体开始寻求 FAA 认证，以于 2025 年 10 月恢复运营。该公司正在寻求第 121 部分认证，这是美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 针对运营大型飞机定期航班（例如客运、货运或包机运营）的航空公司制定的最严格的法规。

据宣布，新航空公司的总部将设在迈阿密，将运营空客飞机，优先选择 A220 或二手 A320。首席执行官埃德·韦格尔此前还于2025年12月在LinkedIn上表示，该航空公司打算“在供应链问题和发动机问题得到解决的未来某个时候”运营空客A320neo。此外，该公司还与艾玛迪斯达成协议，为其 IT 和配送中心提供动力，与 Avengers Flight Group 达成协议，提供模拟器培训，并与空中客车公司达成协议，为制造商的 SkyWise 数字套件提供动力。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
第 121 部分管辖运营大型运输机的定期承运人，这是针对美国航空运营商的最严格的法规。然而，这并不意味着任何人都可以通过航空公司预订机票，因为它还监管阿特拉斯航空、奥姆尼国际航空或新东方航空等运营包机航班的公司。这些法规与商业模式无关，而是与商业模式有关。他们专注于公司的运营、正在飞行的飞机以及维护安全所需的美国联邦航空管理局的监督。
美国联邦航空局将密切审查泛美航空的操作程序、手册、维护计划等，以确保遵守法规。监管机构将验证泛美航空的飞机是否配备安全，同时确保该公司雇用合格的机组人员并接受美国联邦航空局批准的培训。此外，美国联邦航空局将审查泛美航空的航线规划、调度和危险品程序，泛美航空将需要提交完整的文件以供审查。
商业运营商的通用航空航班、重新定位和维护航班
规范大型飞机的定期商业服务；飞行员必须持有 ATPL，这是最严格的操作和维护法规
规范低运力飞机的商业按需包机和通勤服务；飞行员必须持有 CPL，其操作和维护规定不如第 121 部分严格
Kalitta 包机、Wheels Up、精品航空、柜台航空
大部分审查过程涉及检查文件，但美国联邦航空局也将进行现场检查和观察，而泛美航空也需要进行验证测试。这不是一个快速或简单的过程，认证可能需要几个月甚至几年的时间。对于泛美航空这样一家没有收入的新公司来说，这会增加开支，而且 Part 121 认证所需的时间越长，航空公司的财务压力就越大。
尽管使用了历史上最著名的航空公司名称之一，新的泛美航空实际上不会出售商业航班的机票。相反，它将是一家主要飞往拉丁美洲的包机航空公司，稍后将提供定期客运服务。公司领导层此前曾表示，该航空公司将提供三种舱位服务，同时计划运营窄体飞机。这很可能意味着经济舱和额外腿部空间的座位，以及国内头等舱。
新泛美航空将/已经采购什么飞机尚未确定，但空中客车 A220（大概是 A220-300）是领先者。然而，新的 A220 很难获得，而且延误也很常见，因此，如果事实证明很难及时获得 A220，该公司也会考虑使用二手 A320-200 作为备用。目前尚不清楚 A320neo 是否仍然是该计划的一部分，但该航空公司的目标是扩大其窄体机机队，同时增加宽体机。
与此同时，泛美航空正在继续其包机业务，因为它正在销售 2027 年 6 月在整个非洲进行的为期 19 天的全包旅行的机票。该航班将使用仅配置商务舱座位的 757-200 飞机，就像 2025 年的包机一样。这些航班实际上由冰岛航空运营，这意味着它们不受该航空公司获得美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 认证的约束。更重要的是，该公司正在不断扩张，成为一个生活方式品牌，而不仅仅是一家航空公司。
“重新构想非洲之旅”是泛美航空的下一个高端包机，但它不会是最后一个。该航空公司针对豪华私人飞机之旅建立了“Pan Am Journeys”子品牌，并已开放预订 2027 年 9 月搭乘同一架 757 前往爱尔兰的高尔夫主题之旅。新的泛美航空还与荷美航空合作，包租“须德丹”号游轮进行加勒比海之旅，该航线复制原来的泛美航空水上飞机运营的航线，将于 2027 年 10 月出发。

body_en: British Airways adds Colombo and Melbourne in winter expansion - Aviation24.be
Home International Airlines Group (IAG) British Airways British Airways adds Colombo and Melbourne in winter expansion
British Airways has launched its winter 2026/27 programme with a new London Gatwick–Colombo service, increased capacity across 11 long-haul destinations and additional European flights.
The inaugural Colombo flight departed Gatwick on 23 October and arrived the following day. The seasonal route operates three times weekly, offering economy, premium economy and business class.

Melbourne will join the network on 9 January 2027, becoming British Airways’ second Australian destination. Flights will operate from London Heathrow via Kuala Lumpur, with four cabins, including First. The airline is also increasing capacity to destinations including Cape Town, Tokyo, Bridgetown, Kingston and San José.
On its shorter-haul network, British Airways will add frequencies to Rome, Florence, Gothenburg and Jersey. Cairo will gain seven weekly flights, taking the schedule to three daily services.

Fuerteventura flights will move from Gatwick to Heathrow, operating twice weekly from mid-December to April. Palermo becomes a year-round destination, while Thessaloniki’s season extends into November and March.

Winter leisure services include up to 110 weekly Geneva flights across Heathrow, Gatwick and London City during the peak ski season. December Christmas-market connections will include up to five weekly Heathrow–Cologne flights and four to Nuremberg.
BA Euroflyer will also introduce Gatwick–Rovaniemi twice weekly between 4 December and 4 January, complementing existing Ivalo services and British Airways’ daily Heathrow–Tromsø connection.
The winter programme also includes the planned arrival of British Airways’ first refurbished Airbus A380 and additional new aircraft.

英国航空启动了 2026/27 年冬季计划，推出了新的伦敦盖特威克机场 - 科伦坡航线，增加了 11 个长途目的地的运力，并增加了欧洲航班。
科伦坡首航航班于 10 月 23 日从盖特威克机场起飞，并于次日抵达。该季节性航线每周运营 3 趟，提供经济舱、豪华经济舱和商务舱。
墨尔本将于 2027 年 1 月 9 日加入该网络，成为英国航空在澳大利亚的第二个目的地。航班将从伦敦希思罗机场出发经吉隆坡，设有四个客舱，其中包括头等舱。该航空公司还增加了飞往开普敦、东京、布里奇敦、金斯顿和圣何塞等目的地的运力。
在其短途航线网络上，英国航空将增加飞往罗马、佛罗伦萨、哥德堡和泽西岛的航班。开罗每周将增加七趟航班，将班次增至每日三趟。
富埃特文图拉岛航班将从盖特威克机场飞往希思罗机场，从 12 月中旬到 4 月每周运营两班。巴勒莫成为全年旅游的目的地，而塞萨洛尼基的旅游季节则延长至十一月和三月。
冬季休闲服务包括在滑雪旺季期间每周有多达 110 趟日内瓦航班飞往希思罗机场、盖特威克机场和伦敦市。 12 月的圣诞市场航线将包括每周多达 5 趟希思罗机场至科隆的航班以及 4 趟飞往纽伦堡的航班。
BA Euroflyer 还将在 12 月 4 日至 1 月 4 日期间每周推出两次盖特威克 - 罗瓦涅米航班，以补充现有的伊瓦罗航班和英国航空每日希思罗 - 特罗姆瑟航线。
冬季计划还包括英国航空公司第一架翻新空客 A380 和其他新飞机的计划抵达。

body_en: Air France expands winter network and La Première rollout - Aviation24.be
Home Air France KLM Group Air France Air France expands winter network and La Première rollout

Air France will increase capacity to the Americas, Asia and the Iberian Peninsula during winter 2026/27, while extending its new La Première cabin to additional US routes. The airline plans up to 725 daily flights to nearly 170 destinations in 78 countries.

North American seat capacity will rise by 6% compared with the previous winter. Paris Charles de Gaulle–Las Vegas, launched in summer 2026, will continue with three weekly Airbus A350-900 flights. Orlando will receive daily services during peak periods, while Boston will have ten weekly flights.

South American capacity will grow by 3%, with Brazil a particular focus. Rio de Janeiro will receive two daily flights from 21 December, Fortaleza will increase to daily during peak periods, and Salvador de Bahia will gain two weekly frequencies from 18 January. Santiago de Chile will be served up to ten times weekly.

In Asia, where capacity will rise by 2%, Phuket will increase from three to five weekly flights, complementing twice-daily Bangkok services. Air France will also operate twice weekly to the Maldives until early March. In Africa, Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar services will increase from five weekly to daily, while Conakry and Libreville will receive A350-900 aircraft.

The new La Première suites will be available on up to 25 Boeing 777-300ERs during the winter. Deployment includes daily Boston and Houston services, twice-daily Miami flights and, from 1 February 2027, daily New York Newark flights.
Air France says 70% of its fleet now offers its new free high-speed Wi-Fi. It expects coverage to reach 80% by year-end and the entire fleet, including regional aircraft, during 2027.

On short- and medium-haul routes, capacity to Spain and Portugal will increase by 5%. Porto will receive two daily flights, while twice-daily London Gatwick services will continue through winter alongside six daily Heathrow flights. Frequencies will also rise to Zurich, Rabat, Yerevan and several French cities.
Separately, Transavia France plans to operate 174 routes to 89 destinations in 26 countries this winter.

法航将在 2026/27 年冬季增加飞往美洲、亚洲和伊比利亚半岛的运力，同时将其新的 La Première 客舱扩展到更多美国航线。该航空公司计划每天有多达 725 个航班飞往 78 个国家的近 170 个目的地。
北美座位数将比去年冬季增加6%。巴黎戴高乐机场至拉斯维加斯航线于 2026 年夏季开通，将继续每周运营 3 趟空客 A350-900 航班。奥兰多将在高峰时段每天提供服务，而波士顿每周将有十个航班。
南美产能将增长 3%，其中巴西尤其受到关注。从 12 月 21 日起，里约热内卢将每天有两班航班，福塔雷萨将在高峰时段增加到每天两班，萨尔瓦多从 1 月 18 日起将增加每周两班航班。智利圣地亚哥每周最多提供十次服务。
在亚洲，普吉岛的运力将增加 2%，航班将从每周 3 班增加到 5 班，以补充曼谷每日 2 班的服务。法航还将每周运营两班飞往马尔代夫的航班，直至三月初。在非洲，乞力马扎罗山和桑给巴尔岛的航班将从每周五班增加到每天一班，而科纳克里和利伯维尔将接收 A350-900 飞机。
冬季期间，最多 25 架波音 777-300ER 上将提供全新 La Première 套房。部署包括每日波士顿和休斯顿航班、每日两班迈阿密航班以及自 2027 年 2 月 1 日起每日纽约纽瓦克航班。
法航表示，其 70% 的机队现已提供全新的免费高速 Wi-Fi。预计到年底，覆盖率将达到 80%，到 2027 年，整个机队（包括支线飞机）的覆盖率将达到 80%。
在中短途航线上，飞往西班牙和葡萄牙的运力将增加5%。波尔图每天将有两班航班，而每天两班的伦敦盖特威克航班将在整个冬季继续运营，此外希思罗机场每天还将有六班航班。前往苏黎世、拉巴特、埃里温和几个法国城市的班次也将增加。
另外，Transavia France 计划今年冬季运营 174 条航线，飞往 26 个国家的 89 个目的地。

body_en: Lufthansa and Fraport trial counter-free gate at Frankfurt Airport - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Frankfurt Airport (FRA) Lufthansa and Fraport trial counter-free gate at Frankfurt Airport

Lufthansa and Frankfurt Airport operator Fraport have inaugurated a redesigned departure area at Terminal 1’s Gate A16, testing mobile passenger assistance, digital information displays and lounge-style seating.

The “ Gate of the Future ” replaces the conventional fixed service counter with staff carrying tablets. These mobile agents circulate among passengers to help with seat assignments, upgrades and rebooking, using a single interface to access boarding systems and manage gate announcements.

Large wall monitors and 360-degree displays provide departure times, boarding status, hand-luggage guidance and gate-change updates. QR codes give passengers access to digital self-service tools, including the Lufthansa app.
The waiting area also features sofas, artwork and individual work spaces designed to provide greater privacy and quieter surroundings.

Lufthansa and Fraport will assess the concept during normal operations before deciding which elements could be introduced at other gates. The partners aim to improve passenger comfort and make boarding processes more efficient, although no wider rollout timetable or quantified performance targets were announced.

body_en: KLM adds premium seats to Aruba and Bonaire services - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (AMS) KLM adds premium seats to Aruba and Bonaire services
KLM is deploying Boeing 777 and 787-10 aircraft on its Aruba and Bonaire services this winter, increasing premium seating capacity in response to demand for greater comfort.

The change, effective from 25 October, replaces Airbus A330 operations. According to the airline, the Boeing aircraft offer approximately 35 World Business Class seats and 24 Premium Comfort seats, compared with around 30 business-class seats on the A330. Capacity in other cabin categories remains broadly comparable.
Frédérique Pelger, KLM’s vice-president for Benelux, the Dutch Caribbean and Suriname, said passengers were increasingly choosing additional comfort and personalised service.

KLM is also expanding its Amsterdam–Curaçao schedule. The airline will operate nine weekly flights during the winter, rising to ten in January and February, twelve during the Christmas holidays and eleven during the spring school holidays.
The changes coincide with the 90th anniversary of KLM’s first official passenger flight to Bonaire on 31 May 1936.

荷航今年冬季将在其阿鲁巴岛和博内尔岛航线上部署波音 777 和 787-10 飞机，增加高级座位容量，以满足更高舒适度的需求。
这一变化自 10 月 25 日起生效，取代空客 A330 的运营。据该航空公司称，波音飞机提供约 35 个世界商务舱座位和 24 个高级舒适座位，而 A330 则提供约 30 个商务舱座位。其他客舱类别的容量仍然大致可比。
荷航比荷卢经济联盟、荷属加勒比地区和苏里南地区副总裁弗雷德里克·佩尔格 (Frédérique Pelger) 表示，乘客越来越多地选择额外的舒适度和个性化服务。
荷航还扩大了阿姆斯特丹 - 库拉索岛的航班时刻表。该航空公司将在冬季运营每周 9 个航班，一月和二月增加到 10 个，圣诞节假期期间增加到 12 个，春季学校假期期间增加到 11 个。
这些变化恰逢 1936 年 5 月 31 日荷航首次开通飞往博内尔岛的正式客运航班 90 周年。

body_en: 4+ Massive Electrical Blasts Spark New Concerns Over LAX People Mover

Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

Four electrical arc-blast incidents damaged parts of the Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) People Mover’s power rail and guideway in September, raising fresh questions about the safety and readiness of the long-delayed transportation project. Newly released video obtained by FOX 11 Los Angeles shows a large electrical flash erupting along the tracks shortly after a test train passes, adding urgency to concerns already raised by specialists reviewing the incidents.

The incidents were documented in a report prepared for project lenders by infrastructure advisory firm Infrata, according to ABC7 Los Angeles . Three blasts reportedly occurred at separate locations on September 23, followed by a fourth on September 25. The cause remains under investigation, although the project contractor, LINXS, says the affected area was limited and repairs have been completed. With passenger service delayed for years, the findings create another hurdle for an airport project intended to improve access to terminals and regional transit.
Four Electrical Incidents Damaged The People Mover’s Power Infrastructure

The four incidents involved electrical arc blasts, also described as flashovers, on the People Mover’s elevated guideway. According to the Infrata report, the power rail and guide beam sustained damage, while the underlying cause had not been determined at the time of reporting. Transportation and railroad expert Timothy Borchers, who has more than four decades of experience in the field, told ABC7 that four such incidents were unprecedented in his experience. He characterized an arc blast as an uncontrolled electrical explosion and warned that a similar event occurring as a train passed over the affected area could potentially cause a fire.

Video published by FOX 11 provides a closer look at one of the incidents. The footage, recorded during testing in late September, shows a test train passing before a substantial flash erupts near the track, followed by visible sparks and smoke. Borchers told the station that the event was among the most severe flashovers he had witnessed.
Contractor Says Repairs Are Complete As Safety Questions Persist

LINXS, the consortium responsible for designing, building, and operating the People Mover, said the incidents affected only a limited section of the power rail. In a statement reported by ABC7, the contractor said the damage involved a few feet of rail, was not related to the power distribution system, and did not indicate a defect in the installed electrical system. It also reported no damage to the passenger vehicles and said the system responded as designed.

Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA), which operates LAX, said the source of the incidents remained under investigation but that the related issues had been repaired. Officials also confirmed that testing had resumed. The airport has also reportedly referred local news agencies to an informational website explaining that arc flashes can occur during testing.

Testing is intended to expose technical problems before passengers are carried, but repeated electrical failures raise questions about the system’s reliability and the effectiveness of its safeguards. The immediate challenge for project officials is to demonstrate that the system can operate consistently and safely before opening it to the public. Neither the footage nor the statements released so far provide a complete public explanation of the cause.

The electrical incidents come amid years of delays for the Automated People Mover, also known as SkyLink . The project was originally expected to open in 2023, but passenger service has repeatedly been postponed. The system is designed to connect airport terminals with parking facilities, the rental car center, and the LAX Metro Transit Center, reducing reliance on vehicles circulating around the airport.

Project costs have also risen substantially, with a price tag of approximately $3.3 billion, well above the original budget. Separately, the contractor and city have been involved in disputes over delays and responsibility for additional costs, adding financial and legal pressure to an already troubled undertaking. Until officials provide clearer findings on the cause of the four blasts and demonstrate that the corrective work has resolved the problem, the incidents are likely to remain a significant concern for a project already under scrutiny.

Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
9 月份发生的四起电弧爆炸事故损坏了洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 旅客捷运系统的部分电力铁轨和导轨，引发了人们对这一拖延已久的交通项目的安全性和准备情况的新疑问。洛杉矶福克斯11频道获得的新发布的视频显示，测试列车通过后不久，铁轨上爆发出巨大的闪电，这加剧了审查该事件的专家已经提出的担忧的紧迫性。
据 ABC7 Los Angeles 报道，基础设施咨询公司 Infrata 为项目贷款人准备的一份报告中记录了这些事件。据报道，9 月 23 日在不同地点发生了三起爆炸，随后于 9 月 25 日发生了第四起爆炸。尽管项目承包商 LINXS 表示受影响的区域有限且修复工作已经完成，但爆炸原因仍在调查中。由于客运服务延误多年，调查结果给旨在改善航站楼和区域交通通道的机场项目带来了另一个障碍。
四起电气事故损坏了旅客捷运系统的电力基础设施
这四起事故涉及旅客捷运系统高架导轨上的电弧爆炸，也称为闪络。根据 Infrata 的报告，电源轨和导梁受到损坏，但截至报告时尚未确定根本原因。交通和铁路专家蒂莫西·博彻斯(Timothy Borchers)在该领域拥有四十多年的经验，他告诉ABC7，在他的经历中，四起此类事件是前所未有的。他将电弧爆炸描述为不受控制的电气爆炸，并警告说，当火车经过受影响区域时发生的类似事件可能会引起火灾。
FOX 11 发布的视频提供了对其中一起事件的更仔细的观察。这段视频是在九月下旬的测试过程中录制的，显示一列测试列车经过，然后在轨道附近爆发出大量闪光，随后出现可见的火花和烟雾。博彻斯告诉电视台，这次事件是他所目睹的最严重的闪络事件之一。
承包商称由于安全问题仍然存在，维修已完成
负责设计、建造和运营旅客捷运系统的 LINXS 财团表示，这些事件仅影响了电力轨道的有限部分。在 ABC7 报道的一份声明中，承包商表示，损坏涉及几英尺长的铁轨，与配电系统无关，也没有表明已安装的电气系统存在缺陷。它还报告说客车没有受到任何损坏，并表示系统按设计响应。
运营洛杉矶国际机场的洛杉矶世界机场 (LAWA) 表示，事件根源仍在调查中，但相关问题已得到修复。官员们还证实测试已经恢复。据报道，机场还向当地新闻机构推荐了一个信息网站，解释测试期间可能会出现电弧闪光。
测试的目的是在载客之前暴露技术问题，但反复出现的电气故障引发了人们对系统可靠性及其防护措施有效性的质疑。项目官员面临的直接挑战是在向公众开放之前证明该系统能够持续、安全地运行。迄今为止发布的视频和声明都没有对原因提供完整的公开解释。
这些电气事故发生之际，旅客捷运系统（也称为 SkyLink）已经延误多年。该项目原预计于2023年开业，但客运服务一再推迟。该系统旨在将机场航站楼与停车设施、租车中心和洛杉矶国际机场地铁交通中心连接起来，减少对机场周围车辆的依赖。
项目成本也大幅上升，标价约为33亿美元，远高于最初的预算。另外，承包商和市政府因延误和额外费用责任而陷入纠纷，给本已陷入困境的企业增加了财务和法律压力。在官员们对四次爆炸的原因提供更明确的调查结果并证明纠正工作已经解决了问题之前，这些事件可能仍然是一个已经受到审查的项目的重大担忧。

title_en: The Most Flights A Flight Attendant Can Work In A Single Day
title_zh: 空姐一天可以工作最多的航班
summary: Aviation is bound by strict rules and regulations.
summary_zh: 航空业受到严格的规则和规定的约束。
body_en: Writer - Patricia joins Simple Flying with over 20 years of experience in aviation. She has served as cabin crew on flights from economy-class through to first-class and on private jets as well as being head of cabin crew and cabin safety focal point. Patricia has a master's level postgraduate diploma in Human Factors in Aviation and has written about aviation since 2010. Based in Dubai/Cyprus.

Flight attendants often work multiple legs or sectors in a day, which may be returning to base, before a layover, or as part of a multi-leg trip. Long-haul flight attendants generally only work on one sector per day due to much longer flights, whereas those who are scheduled for shorter flights will work anywhere between one and six flights in a day, although on average most crew work two to four flights a day, depending on which trips they are scheduled.

There are, however, very strict Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) rules and regulations for scheduling US flight attendants, which apply more to the number of hours worked in a day rather than the number of flights. It also includes things like rest periods before or after duties and what can happen when things don't go to plan, for example, during diverse weather conditions and delays or technical issues.

There's no legal limit on how many flights a US flight attendant can work in a day. FAA rules limit the length of the duty day, not the number of flights, so the real cap on flights comes from union contracts and their bargaining agreements. The Association of Flight Attendants-CWA (AFA-CWA) is the largest US flight attendant union, representing nearly 50,000 flight attendants across 20 airlines. There is also the Association of Professional Flight Attendants (APFA), which represents flight attendants at American Airlines , and Southwest Airlines is represented by the Transport Workers Union (TWU).

Under 14 CFR 121.467, an airline generally can't schedule a flight attendant for more than 14 hours of duty, unless certain conditions are met. 14 CFR 121.467 addresses flight attendant duty period limitations and rest requirements. In basic terms, a duty period runs from the assignment report time until the flight attendant is released from the assignment. A rest period is a time that is free from all duties. These rules apply to certificate holders conducting domestic, flag, or supplemental operations.

A duty period can only be assigned when the applicable duty period limitations and rest requirements are met. A flight attendant cannot be assigned a scheduled duty period of over 14 hours unless additional crew are carried on the flight, and it usually only applies to ultra-long-haul international flights. Otherwise, the FAA says a scheduled duty period cannot exceed 14 hours.

With extra flight attendants on board and additional rest , the duty period can be extended up to 20 hours on longer trips. A duty period counts from when the flight attendant reports for an assignment until the airline releases them from it, so ground time between flights counts against the 14 hours. An exception allows a duty day to run over when delays are outside the airline's control, as long as the day was originally scheduled within the limit.

A flight attendant may be assigned a duty of more than 14 hours but no more than 16 hours, unless one additional Flight Attendant is carried onboard above the minimum crew complement required. They can also be assigned a duty of more than 16 hours but not more than 18 hours if two additional flight attendants are carried above the minimum crew complement.

A flight attendant may also be assigned a duty of more than 18 hours but no more than 20 hours, including one or more flights that land or take off outside the 48 contiguous states (international flights only), and must carry three additional flight attendants. A standard duty period maxes out at 14 hours with a minimum crew. To work longer than 14 hours, the airline must add extra flight attendants to the crew.

Flight attendants in the US can be scheduled for a duty period of 14 hours but less than 20 hours when additional crew are carried, but must have a scheduled rest period of at least 12 consecutive hours, which must occur between the end of the scheduled duty period and the start of the subsequent duty period. This rest period must be free of all duties. After a duty period exceeding 14 hours, the required rest period increases from the standard 10 consecutive hours to 12 consecutive hours.

This may be reduced to 10 hours if the flight attendant has 14 hours of subsequent rest no later than 24 hours after the start of the reduced rest period and between duties. If rest is reduced to 10 hours, a flight attendant cannot be scheduled for more than a 14-hour duty period during the 24-hour period from the start of the reduced rest period.

Rest rules were changed in October 2022, and the FAA finalized a rule in the Federal Register requiring at least 10 consecutive hours of rest after a duty period of up to 14 hours, up from nine hours, and removed the option to reduce it. Many union contracts negotiate even stricter rest minimums (e.g., 11 hours or more, or extra protections if hotel transit time eats into rest).

Within those limits, union contracts set the number of flights. Sample contract terms cap a duty period at six to eight flights, with no more than five to seven worked by the flight attendant and a maximum of 10 landings, according to the FAA's Legal Interpretation Memorandum on § 121.467 duty periods .

Operators cannot schedule a duty period without the minimum rest required or during required rest periods. Travel times between duties are not included in a rest period. Flight attendants must also have 24 hours of consecutive rest during any seven consecutive days worked. Some airlines also require a flight attendant to be replaced at their home base after 12 hours on duty unless they can finish their remaining flights within 14 hours.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.

A flight attendant is not considered to be scheduled for duty in excess of duty period limitations if the flights to which they are assigned are scheduled and normally terminate within the limitations, but due to circumstances beyond the control of the airline, they are not at the time of departure expected to reach their destination within the scheduled time.

If severe weather or maintenance delays occur while the aircraft is still at the gate, the airline cannot legally force the crew to take off if the delayed schedule would push them past their maximum duty limits. If a delay pushes the estimated arrival time past the flight attendant's maximum duty clock, the crew will "time out". The airline must either bring in a backup crew or cancel/delay the flight further to allow the current crew to take their mandatory rest.
body_zh: 作家 - Patricia 加入 Simple Flying 时拥有 20 多年的航空经验。她曾在从经济舱到头等舱的航班以及私人飞机上担任机组人员，并担任机组人员负责人和客舱安全协调员。 Patricia 拥有航空人为因素硕士学位研究生文凭，自 2010 年以来一直撰写有关航空的文章。居住在迪拜/塞浦路斯。
空乘人员经常在一天内工作多个航段或航段，可能是在中途停留之前返回基地，或者作为多航段旅行的一部分。由于航班距离较长，长途空乘人员通常每天只在一个航段工作，而那些安排短途航班的空乘人员每天会工作一到六个航班，尽管大多数机组人员平均每天工作两到四个航班，具体取决于他们安排的行程。
然而，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）对于安排空乘人员有非常严格的规则和规定，这些规则和规定更多地适用于一天的工作小时数，而不是航班数量。它还包括工作之前或之后的休息时间，以及当事情不按计划进行时可能发生的情况，例如，在不同的天气条件和延误或技术问题期间。
美国空乘人员一天可以工作多少个航班没有法律限制。美国联邦航空局的规则限制了工作日的长度，而不是航班数量，因此航班的真正上限来自工会合同及其谈判协议。空乘人员协会 (AFA-CWA) 是美国最大的空乘人员工会，代表 20 家航空公司的近 50,000 名空乘人员。还有代表美国航空空乘人员的专业空乘人员协会（APFA），以及代表西南航空的运输工人工会（TWU）。
根据 14 CFR 121.467，航空公司通常不能安排空乘人员执勤超过 14 小时，除非满足某些条件。 14 CFR 121.467 规定了空乘人员值班时间限制和休息要求。基本来说，值班期是从任务报告时间开始，直到空乘人员被解除任务为止。休息时间是指没有任何职责的时间。这些规则适用于进行国内、船旗国或补充运营的合格证持有者。
仅当满足适用的工作期限限制和休息要求时，才能分配工作期限。除非航班上载有额外的机组人员，否则空乘人员的预定值班时间不得超过 14 小时，并且通常仅适用于超长途国际航班。否则，FAA 规定预定值班时间不能超过 14 小时。
如果机上有额外的空乘人员和额外的休息，长途旅行的执勤时间可延长至 20 小时。执勤期从空乘人员报到到航空公司释放其为止计算，因此航班之间的地面时间计入 14 小时。当航班延误超出航空公司控制范围时，只要该日最初安排在限制范围内，则例外情况允许延长工作日。
一名空乘人员的工作时间可能超过 14 小时但不超过 16 小时，除非机上额外携带一名空乘人员且超出了所需的最低机组人数。如果在最低机组人数之上增加两名空乘人员，他们也可以被分配超过 16 小时但不超过 18 小时的值班时间。
空乘人员的工作时间也可能超过 18 小时但不超过 20 小时，包括在 48 个相邻州以外降落或起飞的一个或多个航班（仅限国际航班），并且必须额外携带 3 名空乘人员。标准值勤期最长为 14 小时，且人员最少。如果工作时间超过 14 小时，航空公司必须在机组人员中增加额外的空乘人员。
在美国，空乘人员可以安排工作时间为 14 小时，但在携带额外机组人员时，工作时间不得超过 20 小时，但必须有至少连续 12 小时的计划休息时间，且必须在计划工作时间结束和后续工作时间开始之间进行。这段休息时间不得承担任何职责。工作时间超过 14 小时后，所需休息时间从标准的连续 10 小时增加到连续 12 小时。
如果空乘人员在减少的休息时间开始后和值勤之间不迟于 24 小时内有 14 小时的后续休息，则该时间可减少至 10 小时。如果休息时间减少到 10 小时，则在减少休息时间开始后的 24 小时内，空乘人员的工作时间不得超过 14 小时。
休息规则于 2022 年 10 月发生了变化，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 在《联邦公报》中最终确定了一项规则，要求在长达 14 小时的值勤期后至少连续休息 10 小时（从 9 小时增加），并取消了减少休息时间的选项。许多工会合同都协商了更严格的最低休息时间（例如，11 小时或更长，或者如果酒店交通时间占用休息时间则提供额外保护）。
在这些限制内，工会合同规定了航班数量。根据美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 关于第 121.467 条值班期的法律解释备忘录，样本合同条款规定值班期最多为 6 至 8 个航班，空乘人员工作的次数不得超过 5 至 7 次，最多着陆 10 次。
操作员无法在没有最低休息要求的情况下或在要求的休息时间内安排工作时间。工作之间的旅行时间不包括在休息时间内。空乘人员在连续工作 7 天期间还必须有连续 24 小时的休息时间。一些航空公司还要求空乘人员值班 12 小时后在其基地更换，除非他们能够在 14 小时内完成剩余的航班。
紧急呼叫、等待、航行通告 — 实时信号，无需注册。
如果空乘人员所分配的航班已安排并通常在限制内终止，但由于航空公司无法控制的情况，他们在出发时预计无法在预定时间内到达目的地，则该乘务员不被视为安排的值班时间超过了值班期限限制。
如果飞机仍在登机口时发生恶劣天气或维护延误，并且延误的时间表会使机组人员超过其最高值班限制，航空公司就不能合法地强制机组人员起飞。如果延误导致预计抵达时间超过空乘人员的最大值班时间，机组人员将“超时”。航空公司必须引进后备机组人员，或者进一步取消/推迟航班，以使现有机组人员得到强制休息。

body_en: Inquiry continues into Brussels Airlines ground injury at Birmingham - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Birmingham Airport (BHX) Inquiry continues into Brussels Airlines ground injury at Birmingham
An investigation remains ongoing one year after a ground crew member suffered serious leg injuries when a Brussels Airlines aircraft began rolling following pushback at Birmingham Airport.

The incident occurred on 24 October 2025 and involved Airbus A319 OO-SSF. According to the UK Air Accidents Investigation Branch (AAIB), the tug had been disconnected and moved away when the aircraft started to roll, injuring the headset operator.
France’s aviation safety investigation authority, the BEA, confirmed that the injured worker was a member of the pushback team.
Aviation Safety Network records identify the aircraft as an A319-111 operating flight SN2048 and place the incident at gate 41. No fatalities or aircraft damage were reported.

The AAIB has not established the cause of the movement or assigned responsibility. Investigators are examining possible technical, operational, human and organisational factors, with a final report to be published once the inquiry is complete.

summary: GHA Discovery's paid status match offers Titanium or Platinum status through 2027, plus bonus Discovery Dollars that offset the fee. Here's how it works and how my application went.
summary_zh: GHA Discovery 的付费身份匹配提供钛金级或白金级身份直至 2027 年，以及可抵消费用的额外 Discovery Dollars。这是它的工作原理
body_en: GHA Discovery is a hotel loyalty program that flies under the radar, but really shouldn’t. It offers the ability to earn and redeem rewards, and take advantage of elite perks, at hundreds of properties around the globe, including some small, luxury hotel groups ( like Capella Hotels & Resorts ).

Along those lines, GHA Discovery is currently offering a lucrative paid status match promotion in partnership with statusmatch.com, which may interest some people. This was available earlier in the year, and the offer has just returned. I’d like to go over the details, and also share my experience, as I took advantage of this the last time it was offered.
Basics of the GHA Discovery status match promotion

GHA Discovery is offering a status match to either Titanium or Platinum status. This is an outright match, and status is valid through December 31, 2027 (so there’s no status challenge element to this). This offer is valid for applications through November 30, 2026, though that remains subject to change, and the offer could be pulled earlier, depending on interest.
Matching to GHA Discovery Titanium comes with a fee of $150, but offers a reward of D$75, while matching to GHA Discovery Platinum comes with a fee of $100, but offers a reward of D$50.

For those not familiar, the “D$” refers to Discovery Dollars, and the idea is that each D$ gets you a dollar off an eligible hotel stay. In other words, this match will really only cost you $50-75, assuming you are able to use the D$.

If you go to the application page and click on the FAQs, you can see a matrix that shows how status maps over between programs. GHA Discovery is matching status with airlines, hotels, and cruise lines, and generally upper tier status earns Titanium, while lower tier status earns Platinum. Certain credit cards are also being matched.
A GHA Discovery status match could be a good value
I slept on the GHA Discovery program for far too long. I don’t want to say it’s the world’s most exciting loyalty program, but a few things stand out to me

It’s really cool to see the huge number of otherwise independent brands that participate in GHA Discovery, ranging from Capella, to Corinthia, to Kempinski, to Patina; best of all, you can even still earn and redeem rewards and take advantage of elite perks when booking through a program like Virtuoso
I appreciate the program’s flexibility, as you can redeem D$ toward only part of the cost of a stay, so you don’t have to be a super loyal guest to get value from the program
The elite perks with GHA Discovery are actually solid, like Titanium members receiving a double upgrade subject to availability

I decided to submit a GHA Discovery status match request. I appreciate how there’s no challenge requirement to it, how it’s valid for well over a year, and also how many brands are included. For example, I love Capella properties, and plan to stay at more of those while this status is valid, so hopefully that comes in handy.

How did my status match application go? It was super painless, and took maybe one minute. When you go to the page to request a match , you’ll first be asked to enter your first and last name, your email address, and whether you’re trying to match airline status, hotel status, or a credit card.
On the next page, you’ll be asked to enter specifically which program you’re trying to match, what status you have, and what your membership number is.

On the next page, you have to upload proof of your status. This can either come in the form of taking a picture of a physical card, or otherwise taking a photo of your computer screen or tablet, while logged into your account. You can’t edit or crop the screen image.
Next, you’ll be asked to review the application, and pay the fee.
You then receive confirmation of the successful request, noting that it can take two business days for status to be upgraded, and that it can take 10 business days for the bonus D$ to post.
A little under 24 hours after submitting my application, I received an email indicating that my status match was approved, and it included a link to activate my new status.
That link asked me to log into my GHA Discovery account, and then I could immediately confirm that I wanted my status upgraded.
body_zh: GHA Discovery 是一项低调的酒店忠诚度计划，但实际上不应该如此。它提供了在全球数百家酒店（包括一些小型豪华酒店集团（如嘉佩乐酒店及度假村））赚取和兑换奖励并享受精英福利的能力。

GHA Discovery 状态匹配促销的基础知识
GHA Discovery 提供与钛金或白金身份相匹配的身份。这是一场完全匹配，状态有效期截至 2027 年 12 月 31 日（因此不存在状态挑战元素）。此优惠对 2026 年 11 月 30 日之前的申请有效，但仍可能发生变化，并且优惠可能会提前取消，具体取决于兴趣。
匹配 GHA Discovery 钛金的费用为 150 美元，但提供 75 美元的奖励；而匹配 GHA Discovery 白金的费用为 100 美元，但提供 50 美元的奖励。

如果您转到应用程序页面并单击常见问题解答，您可以看到一个矩阵，显示状态如何在程序之间映射。 GHA Discovery 与航空公司、酒店和游轮公司的等级相匹配，通常较高级别的级别可赚取钛金卡，而较低级别的级别可赚取白金卡。某些信用卡也正在匹配中。
GHA Discovery 状态匹配可能很有价值
我在 GHA Discovery 计划中睡得太久了。我不想说这是世界上最令人兴奋的忠诚度计划，但有几件事对我来说很突出

GHA Discovery 的精英福利实际上很丰厚，比如钛金会员可根据供应情况获得双重升级
我决定提交 GHA Discovery 状态匹配请求。我很欣赏它没有任何挑战要求，它的有效期长达一年多，以及其中包含的品牌数量。例如，我喜欢嘉佩乐 (Capella) 的房产，并计划在该状态有效期间入住更多此类房产，因此希望这能派上用场。
我的身份匹配申请进展如何？这非常无痛，大约只需要一分钟。当您转到请求匹配的页面时，系统首先会要求您输入您的名字和姓氏、电子邮件地址以及您是否要尝试匹配航空公司状态、酒店状态或信用卡。
在下一页上，系统会要求您具体输入您要匹配的计划、您的状态以及您的会员编号。
在下一页上，您必须上传您的身份证明。这可以是在登录您的帐户时拍摄实体卡的照片，也可以以其他方式拍摄您的计算机屏幕或平板电脑的照片。您无法编辑或裁剪屏幕图像。
接下来，系统会要求您审核申请并支付费用。
然后，您会收到请求成功的确认信息，并指出状态升级可能需要 2 个工作日，红利 D$ 可能需要 10 个工作日才能过账。
提交申请后不到 24 小时，我收到一封电子邮件，表明我的状态匹配已获得批准，其中包含激活我的新状态的链接。
该链接要求我登录我的 GHA Discovery 帐户，然后我可以立即确认我想要升级我的状态。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

Allegiant Air's scheduled operations are exclusively domestic. Between November 2026 and next May, Cirium Diio data shows that the ultra-low-cost carrier's airframes will be seen in 123 airports across the country, with many, of course, being secondary or tiny . Orlando Sanford will have the most flights, followed by Tampa St. Pete and Punta Gorda.

Allegiant is renowned for how dramatically flights change depending on the day, influenced by its generally older aircraft that do not have to be used as intensively. Tuesdays account for just 5% of the airline's total services, against 20% for Sundays. This means that the carrier does not have to discount even more aggressively to consistently fill aircraft.
The Airline Stopped Flying To These Airports In 2026

Schedule analysis for January to October 2026 shows that the following four airports have stopped seeing the airline's aircraft . All carriers have route and airport churn, and Allegiant is no exception. It is notable that most of the entries were part of its map for many years.

Technically, Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) and Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) are still served. However, this is not by Allegiant itself, but rather by Sun Country, which is now wholly owned by the Allegiant Travel Company . While Sun Country does not fly to Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (OAK), it does serve San Francisco itself. Unsurprisingly, routes from these places only exist to Minneapolis, although passengers can connect there to reach elsewhere.

Significantly, three of the four eliminated airports are in California, which followed the removal of flights to San Diego in September 2025. As such, Allegiant now only serves six places in the Golden State: Burbank, Fresno, Monterey, Orange County, Santa Maria, and Stockton. The enormous LA Basin remains served through Burbank and Orange County, while San Francisco Bay has been removed from its map.

The ultra-low-cost carrier arrived at LAX on May 1, 2009. That day, two routes were available to Grand Junction and Medford. A further 11 markets launched that spring month: Bellingham, Billings, Des Moines, Fargo, McAllen, Missoula, Monterey, Northwest Arkansas, Sioux Falls, Springfield, and Wichita.

In the subsequent 17 years, a further 29 routes existed: Albuquerque, Boise, Bozeman, Cedar Rapids, Cincinnati, Eugene, Grand Rapids, Great Falls, Honolulu, Idaho Falls, Indianapolis, Jackson Hole, Kalispell, Laredo, Las Vegas, Little Rock, Memphis, Montrose, Ogden, Oklahoma City, Omaha, Pasco, Provo, Rapid City, Reno, Rockford, Shreveport, Spokane, and Tulsa. The following table shows Allegiant's top ten LAX routes.
* According to the US Department of Transportation (DOT)

Between 2009 and 2026, the US DOT shows that Allegiant transported a total of 5.8 million passengers to/from LAX. When all airlines are included, LAX had 826 million domestic passengers. As such, Allegiant accounted for just one in every 143 of them.

Since 2009, Allegiant's total load factor at the major airport was 86.4%. As always, this is just one performance measure and says nothing about the fares needed to achieve it. Inevitably, some routes did very poorly, such as the ultra-competitive Las Vegas, which had regular service between June and August 2019 and in July 2020. In those months, just 31.7% of seats were filled.
Allegiant Returned To Columbia, South Carolina, In 2025

Originally, Allegiant served CAE from Fort Lauderdale, Orlando Sanford, and Tampa-St Pete. Flights returned after a 16-year absence in May 2025, albeit only from Sanford. Things did not work well, as the DOT indicates that only 47.3% of seats were filled. Allegiant pulled out 12 months after returning.

最初，Allegiant 在劳德代尔堡、奥兰多桑福德和坦帕-圣皮特提供 CAE 服务。时隔 16 年之后，航班于 2025 年 5 月回归，不过仅从桑福德起飞。事情进展并不顺利，交通部表示只有 47.3% 的席位已满。 Allegiant 在回归 12 个月后退出。

title_en: Southwest Airlines The Ditched World's Busiest Airport In 2026: Here's Why
title_zh: 西南航空将在 2026 年放弃世界上最繁忙的机场：原因如下
summary: A network rethink reshaped Southwest's Chicago presence, prioritizing Midway's higher load factors and stability.
summary_zh: 网络重新思考重塑了西南航空在芝加哥的业务，优先考虑中途岛的更高载客率和稳定性。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

The world's largest low-cost carrier (or hybrid carrier, as many would argue) withdrew from the world's busiest airport for by flights (as opposed to passenger numbers) this year. Southwest Airlines said goodbye to Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD), as it shifted its focus to a more consolidated operation in the Windy City, with all flights now operating from Chicago Midway (MDW).
Southwest had operated nonstop flights from O'Hare to 13 domestic and international destinations since 2021. However, in 2026 the airline decided to move all its operations to Midway.
Southwest Airlines Exits O'Hare In Favor Of Midway

Southwest has operated at Midway for over 40 years, having commenced operations in Midway in 1985. In 2021, the airline took a punt at O'Hare in the pandemic era to compete against the country's major legacy carriers, United and American. The airline struggled to gain ground at the world's busiest airport by flights, with its market share only reaching 1.7% .

O'Hare continued to be difficult for Southwest to grow. Federal Aviation Administration summer flight caps, paired with weak load factors and high operating costs, resulted in the airline ending its operations.

Data from Cirium, an aviation analytics company, shows that Southwest carried 8.9 million passengers from O'Hare between 2021 and 2026. The airline achieved a load factor of 75.3%, below the industry benchmark of 80%, compared to Midway, which averages 82.3%
13 Southwest Routes Canceled from Chicago O'Hare

During its time at O'Hare, Southwest operated 13 destinations: 12 domestic within the United States and a single international route to the popular Mexican tourist destination of Cancun . Domestically, the airline flew to eight destinations in the South, one in the Northeast, and three in the West.
Nashville (BNA), Austin (AUS), Dallas Love Field (DAL), Orlando (MCO), Panama City Beach area (ECP), Fort Lauderdale (FLL), Fort Myers (RSW), Tampa (TPA)

At O'Hare, United and American dominate flight operations, collectively accounting for 80% of all flights, and served 68 million passengers between June 2025 and May 2026, according to The Frequent Flier, citing BTS data . The third and fourth biggest airlines are Delta Air Lines , operating 3.3% of flights, followed by Frontier at 1.9% of flights. Spirit Airlines, before its demise earlier this year, held around 2% of all flights at the airport.

Midway is the second busiest airport in Chicago and is located on the southwest side of the city. Southwest maintains more than 90% of all flight operations at the airport and, between June 2025 and May 2026, carried 17.3 million passengers, per The Frequent Flier.

body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
全球最大的低成本航空公司（或许多人认为的混合航空公司）今年从世界上最繁忙的机场撤出航班（而不是乘客数量）。西南航空告别了芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场 (ORD)，将重点转移到风城更加整合的运营上，所有航班现在均从芝加哥中途机场 (MDW) 起飞。
自 2021 年以来，西南航空已运营从奥黑尔飞往 13 个国内和国际目的地的直飞航班。然而，该航空公司于 2026 年决定将其所有业务迁至中途岛。
西南航空退出奥黑尔机场转而选择中途岛航空
西南航空于 1985 年开始在中途岛运营，已在中途岛运营了 40 多年。2021 年，该航空公司在疫情期间在奥黑尔机场下注，与美国主要的传统航空公司联合航空和美国航空竞争。该航空公司在全球最繁忙机场的航班上举步维艰，市场份额仅达到1.7%。
奥黑尔机场继续阻碍西南航空的发展。美国联邦航空管理局夏季航班上限，加上载客率低和运营成本高，导致该航空公司结束了运营。
航空分析公司 Cirium 的数据显示，2021 年至 2026 年间，西南航空从奥黑尔机场运送了 890 万名乘客。该航空公司的载客率为 75.3%，低于 80% 的行业基准，而中途岛的平均载客率为 82.3%
取消从芝加哥奥黑尔出发的 13 条西南航线
在奥黑尔机场期间，西南航空运营 13 个目的地：12 个美国国内航线和一条飞往墨西哥热门旅游目的地坎昆的国际航线。在国内，该航空公司飞往南部的 8 个目的地、东北部的 1 个目的地和西部的 3 个目的地。
纳什维尔 (BNA)、奥斯汀 (AUS)、达拉斯爱田 (DAL)、奥兰多 (MCO)、巴拿马城海​​滩区 (ECP)、劳德代尔堡 (FLL)、迈尔斯堡 (RSW)、坦帕 (TPA)
据《飞行常客》援引 BTS 数据称，在奥黑尔机场，美联航和美国航空主导着航班运营，合计占所有航班的 80%，在 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期间为 6800 万名乘客提供服务。第三和第四大航空公司是达美航空，运营 3.3% 的航班，其次是边疆航空，运营 1.9% 的航班。精神航空 (Spirit Airlines) 在今年早些时候停业之前，占据了该机场约 2% 的航班。
中途岛机场是芝加哥第二繁忙的机场，位于城市的西南侧。据《飞行常客》报道，西南航空承担着该机场 90% 以上的航班运营，2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期间运送了 1,730 万名乘客。

title_en: Business Class Suites: 7 Airlines With Closing Doors In 2026
title_zh: 商务舱套房：7 家航空公司将于 2026 年关闭
summary: These seven airlines operate more aircraft equipped with sliding doors in business class than any other in the world.
summary_zh: 这七家航空公司运营的商务舱配备滑动门的飞机数量比世界上任何其他航空公司都多。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

The new feature in business class that high-end passengers are craving is sliding doors. First introduced over a decade ago, they let customers essentially shut themselves off from the rest of the cabin, and any airline offering a top business class seat generally needs to offer privacy doors today. It has become increasingly popular, but some airlines offer more suites with doors across their fleets than others.

JetBlue was the first airline to offer sliding doors in business class, present on four out of the 16 seats in the carrier's original 2014 Mint cabin. Qatar Airways was the first airline to offer sliding doors at every seat with its QSuite in 2017, while Delta did the same later that same year with its Delta One Suite. Today, in 2026, these are the seven airlines operating the most aircraft equipped with business class suite doors.

The Lufthansa Allegris project involves a full nose-to-tail update of the airline's widebody interiors for all cabins. In business class, this includes a custom direct-aisle-access seat based on the Safran Optima IP, supplied by Stelia Aerospace, Collins Aerospace, or Thompson Aero Seating, depending on the aircraft type. Allegris is now available on 28 Lufthansa aircraft, split between ten Airbus A350-900s and 18 Boeing 787-9s.

One of the defining characteristics of the Allegris business class is that Lufthansa offers five different types of seats. However, only one of them, the front-row 'Suite', offers sliding doors, plus higher privacy partitions and significantly more personal space. It's among the best business class seats in the world and is available on all Allegris aircraft, but these are the only seats in the cabin with doors.

All future Lufthansa A350 and 787 deliveries will come with Allegris, while Lufthansa will retrofit most of its current A350-900s with the interiors (a handful of A350s acquired second-hand will leave the fleet). In addition, the carrier will retrofit Allegris onto its 17 Boeing 747-8s.
28 aircraft equipped with business class suites

China Eastern mainly relies on the Airbus A330 for short-to-medium range flights, while the Boeing 777-300ER is its flagship aircraft type. Its best business class product, however, can be found on its A350-900s and 787-9s, which are equipped with the Thompson VantageXL. This staggered seat product offers sliding doors and was one of the first business-class seats to include them.

China Eastern Airlines operates 20 A350-900s and eight 787-9s, for a total of 28 aircraft. This is the same number as Lufthansa's current Allegris fleet, but China Eastern offers sliding doors at every seat, which bumps it up this list. However, the German flag carrier is actively taking more new widebodies, whereas China Eastern has no outstanding A350 or 787 orders as of the time of writing.

These same seats also appear on Shanghai Airlines' 787-9s, as it is a wholly owned subsidiary of China Eastern, and they also offer sliding doors. While the Thompson VantageXL has been around for a while, it remains a top choice for long-haul travel, making China Eastern a top choice for nonstop flights to or from China when this product is available.
32 aircraft equipped with business class suites

KLM is the smaller airline of the two within Air France-KLM Group, but it has still received thorough investments for its long-haul product. The A330s are equipped with older seats configured six-abreast in business class, but KLM's Boeing 777s and 787s feature reverse herringbone lie-flats that offer direct aisle access. In addition, the seats on the 777 are equipped with privacy doors.

KLM currently operates 15 777-200ERs and 16 777-300ERs, for a total of 31 777s. Both of these aircraft types are equipped with the Jamco Venture, which is also used on the airline's 787-10s. The Dreamliner version is slightly older and lacks privacy doors, which are installed on the version used on the 777s.

KLM is starting to take delivery of new A350-900s, one of which is now on property . These planes are equipped with the Stelia Opera WB, a product Air France also uses on its A350s. Similar to the Jamco seat, this reverse herringbone model offers sliding doors, bringing KLM's fleet of suite-equipped widebodies to 32 aircraft with more on the way.
45 aircraft equipped with business class suites

Just like its Dutch sister, Air France has invested in its long-haul cabins to offer a consistently excellent business class product. Apart from the A330s, of which there are only five, all of Air France's widebodies offer reverse herringbone seats with direct aisle access, although some aircraft feature different seat models.

In 2023, Air France unveiled its first retrofitted 777-300ER with its latest long-haul interiors, including the Safran Versa for business class. This is an improved reverse-herringbone seat offering more space, better ergonomics, updated technology, and a sliding door. Later that year, the airline began taking delivery of new A350-900s in a premium-heavy layout and equipped with the Stelia Opera WB, a very similar product. Its first 20 A350s have different interiors and layouts.

So far, Air France has taken delivery of 23 A350-900s with the Stelia Opera WB, while retrofitting 22 777-300ERs with the Safran Versa. Of these, 18 aircraft also feature the airline's new La Premiere seats , while the remaining four are configured in a three-class layout with 48 business class seats.

body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
高端乘客渴望的公务舱新功能是滑动门。它们在十多年前首次推出，让乘客基本上与机舱的其他部分隔绝，而如今任何提供顶级商务舱座位的航空公司通常都需要提供隐私门。它变得越来越受欢迎，但一些航空公司提供的带门的套房比其他航空公司更多。
捷蓝航空是第一家在商务舱提供滑动门的航空公司，该公司 2014 年最初的 Mint 客舱共有 16 个座位，其中有 4 个配备了滑动门。卡塔尔航空于 2017 年推出 QSuite，成为第一家在每个座位上提供滑动门的航空公司，而达美航空也在同年晚些时候推出了 Delta One Suite。到了 2026 年，今天，这些是运营最多配备商务舱套房门的飞机的七家航空公司。

汉莎航空 Allegris 项目涉及对航空公司所有客舱的宽体内饰进行全面更新。在商务舱中，这包括基于 Safran Optima IP 的定制直接通道座椅，由 Stelia Aerospace、Collins Aerospace 或 Thompson Aero Seating 提供，具体取决于飞机类型。 Allegris 现已应用于 28 架汉莎航空飞机，其中包括 10 架空客 A350-900 飞机和 18 架波音 787-9 飞机。
Allegris 商务舱的显着特征之一是汉莎航空提供五种不同类型的座位。然而，其中只有前排“套房”提供滑动门、更高的隐私隔断和更多的个人空间。它是世界上最好的商务舱座椅之一，所有 Allegris 飞机上均配备，但这是客舱中唯一带门的座椅。
汉莎航空未来交付的所有 A350 和 787 都将配备 Allegris，而汉莎航空将对其现有的大部分 A350-900 进行内饰改造（少数购买的二手 A350 将离开机队）。此外，该航空公司还将对其 17 架波音 747-8 飞机进行 Allegris 改装。
28架飞机配备商务舱套间
东航主要依靠空客A330执飞中短程航班，波音777-300ER为其旗舰机型。然而，其最好的商务舱产品是配备 Thompson VantageXL 的 A350-900 和 787-9。这款交错座椅产品提供滑动门，是首批配备滑动门的商务舱座椅之一。
中国东方航空运营 20 架 A350-900 飞机和 8 架 787-9 飞机，共有 28 架飞机。这与汉莎航空目前的 Allegris 机队数量相同，但东航在每个座位上都配备了滑动门，这使得东航的排名有所上升。然而，这家德国旗舰航空公司正在积极接收更多新型宽体飞机，而截至撰写本文时，东航还没有未完成的 A350 或 787 订单。
这些相同的座椅也出现在上海航空公司的 787-9 飞机上，因为它是东航的全资子公司，并且还提供滑动门。尽管 Thompson VantageXL 已经推出了一段时间，但它仍然是长途旅行的首选，这使得东航成为该产品上市后往返中国直飞航班的首选。
32架飞机配备商务舱套间
荷航是法航荷航集团旗下两家航空公司中规模较小的一家，但其长途产品仍获得了全面投资。 A330 商务舱配备了六并排的老式座椅，但荷航的波音 777 和 787 则采用反向人字形平躺座椅，可直接通往过道。此外，777上的座椅还配备了隐私门。
荷航目前运营 15 777-200ER 和 16 777-300ER，总计 31 777。这两种机型均配备了 Jamco Venture，该系统也用于该航空公司的 787-10 飞机上。梦想客机版本稍旧，缺少隐私门，而 777 上使用的版本则安装了隐私门。
荷航开始接收新的 A350-900 飞机，其中一架现已交付使用。这些飞机配备了 Stelia Opera WB，法航也在其 A350 上使用了该产品。与 Jamco 座椅类似，这款反向人字形型号提供滑动门，使荷航配备套件的宽体飞机机队数量达到 32 架，而且数量还在不断增加。
45架飞机配备商务舱套间
就像它的荷兰姐妹公司一样，法航对其长途客舱进行了投资，以提供始终如一的卓越商务舱产品。除了仅有 5 架的 A330 之外，法航的所有宽体飞机均提供可直接进入过道的反人字形座椅，尽管有些飞机配备了不同的座椅型号。
2023 年，法航推出了第一架改装的 777-300ER，配备最新的长途内饰，其中包括商务舱 Safran Versa。这是一款改进的反人字形座椅，提供更多空间、更好的人体工程学设计、更新的技术和滑动门。同年晚些时候，该航空公司开始接收新型 A350-900，采用优质重型布局，并配备了非常相似的产品 Stelia Opera WB。其前 20 架 A350 拥有不同的内饰和布局。
迄今为止，法航已通过 Stelia Opera WB 接收了 23 架 A350-900 飞机，同时通过 Safran Versa 改装了 22 架 777-300ER。其中，18 架飞机还配备了该航空公司的全新 La Premiere 座椅，其余 4 架飞机采用三舱布局，设有 48 个商务舱座椅。
