title_en: The Busiest International Routes From The US In 2026
title_zh: 2026 年最繁忙的美国国际航线
summary: Short-hop frequencies tilt the rankings toward Toronto, Vancouver, and Mexico City, while major long-haul flights stay prominent.
summary_zh: 短途航班频率使排名向多伦多、温哥华和墨西哥城倾斜，而主要的长途航班仍然占据主导地位。
body_en: Ethan is an aviation professional with a degree in Aviation Management with Flight from the Florida Institute of Technology. He previously wrote aviation and tourism features for Florida Tech’s student newspaper, The Crimson , where he developed a clear, reader‑focused reporting style. Aviation journalism has remained a consistent priority throughout his career.

He currently holds a Restricted ATP and Commercial Multi‑Engine Pilot certificate and works in aviation supply chain and aircraft component repair. Alongside his industry role, he is pursuing his Certified Flight Instructor rating and actively building flight experience.
A lifelong aviation enthusiast, Ethan spent countless hours at Raleigh–Durham International Airport’s observation deck studying air traffic and practicing amateur photography and videography.

Ranked 9th on Passport Index , the United States passport offers a healthy number of visa-free destinations for US citizens and, conversely, visa-free access for many foreign nationals. This drives strong demand for international air travel, though studies show a recent dip in 2026.

Several metrics can be used to measure the busiest commercial routes in global airspace today. Common differentiators include frequency, total passenger count, load factor, and even the number of airlines operating the city pair. Based solely on annual frequency, Cirium data shows nine routes originating in the US to an international destination, each with more than 3,000 frequencies per year. Canada appears several times on the list, and may be considered one of the most surprising destinations in the wake of the ongoing trade war .

Amid a historic disruption of economic activity between the United States and Canada, complications have spread to the commercial , corporate , and military aviation sectors. Cities north of the border, notably Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ), represent nearly half of the busiest international routes from the US. Most travelers would probably guess New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) - London Heathrow Airport (LHR) or Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) - Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) as the busiest international route from the United States. But frequency data tells a different story.

Four of the nine busiest international routes from the United States connect to Canadian airports, and together they account for 23,463 departures. In other words, more than half of all flights operating on the top-ranked international city pairs involve Canada rather than Europe, Latin America, or the Caribbean. This represents 50.7%, or a slight majority of the top nine reported city pairs.
Top International Routes from the US by Frequency Combined for over 46,000 Annual Flights
Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD) - Toronto
Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) - Vancouver International Airport (YVR)
Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) - Toronto
Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) - Mexico City International Airport (MEX)
New York JFK- Paris Charles De Gaulle Airport (CDG)
Miami International Airport (MIA) - Bogota (BOG)

New York area airports to Toronto specifically account for two of these entries. American Airlines , Delta Air Lines , and United Airlines each serve Toronto from one or more of EWR, LGA, and JFK. Meanwhile, Porter Airlines and Air Canada connect the two cities on behalf of Canada. Air Canada recently cut JFK-YYZ in the wake of decreased transborder demand, rising fuel costs, and a push to consolidate operations at EWR and LGA. JFK currently lacks a meaningful presence of Star Alliance partner United, providing more incentive to codeshare traffic available at EWR and, to a lesser extent, LGA. United has, however, indicated a desire to return to JFK.
New York to London Remains The Top Transatlantic Market

While Toronto benefits from frequency, New York JFK to London Heathrow remains one of the world's most commercially important aviation markets. The route recorded 7,338 departures during 2026, placing it just behind LaGuardia-Toronto despite operating flights that are nearly seven hours long.

Multiple carriers support this volume, including British Airways , American Airlines, Virgin Atlantic , Delta, and JetBlue . United supplements this volume with its Heathrow service from nearby Newark, However, its figures are omitted from Cirium's account. Unlike domestic-style shuttle markets, JFK-Heathrow attracts premium business travelers, government traffic, financial-sector demand, and a significant number of connecting passengers flowing through both hubs.

This segment even creeps its way into the Top 10 Busiest International Routes by number of seats, sitting at number 10 per OAG and as the sole US route on that list. But even Heathrow's global profile could not prevent Canadian routes from filling so much of the frequency leaderboard, raising a deeper question about what airlines actually value: passenger volume or flight frequency?

The distinction lies in aircraft utilization. Airlines can schedule several roundtrips per day on routes such as Toronto, Vancouver, or Mexico City using the same aircraft. A narrowbody operating between New York and Toronto may complete multiple rotations during a single day, something impossible on a transatlantic sector. High aircraft availability for shorter routes helps bolster the associated high frequencies.
body_zh: Ethan 是一名航空专业人士，拥有佛罗里达理工学院飞行管理学位。他此前曾为佛罗里达理工学院的学生报纸《The Crimson》撰写航空和旅游专题文章，在那里他开发了一种清晰、以读者为中心的报道风格。在他的整个职业生涯中，航空新闻始终是优先考虑的事情。
他目前持有受限 ATP 和商业多引擎飞行员证书，从事航空供应链和飞机部件维修工作。除了他的行业角色外，他还追求认证飞行教练评级并积极积累飞行经验。
伊森是一位终生的航空爱好者，他在罗利-达勒姆国际机场的观景台上花费了无数时间研究空中交通并练习业余摄影和摄像。
美国护照在护照指数中排名第九，为美国公民提供大量免签证目的地，同时也为许多外国公民提供免签证入境。这推动了国际航空旅行的强劲需求，尽管研究显示近期国际航空旅行需求在 2026 年会有所下降。
可以使用多种指标来衡量当今全球空域中最繁忙的商业航线。常见的区别因素包括频率、乘客总数、载客率，甚至运营该城市对的航空公司数量。仅根据年度班次，Cirium 数据显示有 9 条从美国出发飞往国际目的地的航线，每条航线每年的班次超过 3,000 趟。加拿大多次出现在名单上，可能被认为是持续贸易战后最令人惊讶的目的地之一。
在美国和加拿大之间的经济活动遭受历史性破坏的情况下，复杂情况已蔓延到商业、企业和军用航空领域。边境以北的城市，尤其是多伦多皮尔逊国际机场 (YYZ)，占美国最繁忙国际航线的近一半。大多数旅客可能会猜测纽约约翰·F·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) - 伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 或洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) - 东京羽田机场 (HND) 是从美国出发的最繁忙的国际航线。但频率数据却讲述了不同的故事。
从美国出发的 9 条最繁忙的国际航线中有 4 条连接加拿大机场，总共有 23,463 架次出发航班。换句话说，在排名靠前的国际城市对上运营的所有航班中，超过一半涉及加拿大，而不是欧洲、拉丁美洲或加勒比地区。这占 50.7%，即报告的前 9 个城市对中的微弱多数。
按班次计算的来自美国的顶级国际航线每年航班总数超过 46,000 架次
芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场 (ORD) - 多伦多
西雅图-塔科马国际机场 (SEA) - 温哥华国际机场 (YVR)
纽瓦克自由国际机场 (EWR) - 多伦多
休斯顿乔治·布什洲际机场 (IAH) - 墨西哥城国际机场 (MEX)
纽约肯尼迪机场 - 巴黎戴高乐机场 (CDG)
迈阿密国际机场 (MIA) - 波哥大 (BOG)

纽约地区飞往多伦多的机场专门占其中两个条目。美国航空、达美航空和联合航空均从 EWR、LGA 和 JFK 中的一个或多个航班飞往多伦多。与此同时，波特航空和加拿大航空代表加拿大连接这两个城市。由于跨境需求减少、燃油成本上升以及 EWR 和 LGA 运营整合的推动，加拿大航空最近削减了 JFK-YYZ 航班。肯尼迪机场目前缺乏星空联盟合作伙伴美联航的有意义的存在，这为 EWR 以及较小程度上 LGA 的代码共享流量提供了更多激励。然而，曼联表示希望重返肯尼迪机场。
纽约至伦敦仍然是最大的跨大西洋市场
虽然多伦多受益于航班频率，但纽约肯尼迪机场至伦敦希思罗机场仍然是世界上最重要的商业航空市场之一。 2026 年，该航线的出发航班量为 7,338 趟，尽管航班时长近 7 小时，但仍仅次于拉瓜迪亚机场 - 多伦多。
多家航空公司支持此卷，包括英国航空、美国航空、维珍航空、达美航空和捷蓝航空。联合航空通过从附近的纽瓦克出发的希思罗机场航班补充了此卷，但 Cirium 的账户中省略了其数据。与国内风格的班车市场不同，肯尼迪-希思罗机场吸引了优质商务旅客、政府交通、金融部门需求以及流经两个枢纽的大量转机乘客。
该航段甚至跻身按座位数计算的十大最繁忙国际航线中，在 OAG 中排名第 10，并且是该名单上唯一的美国航线。但即使是希思罗机场的全球形象也无法阻止加拿大航线占据如此多的航班频率排行榜，这引发了一个更深层次的问题：航空公司真正看重的是什么：乘客量还是航班频率？
区别在于飞机的利用率。航空公司可以使用同一架飞机每天在多伦多、温哥华或墨西哥城等航线上安排多次往返。一架在纽约和多伦多之间运营的窄体飞机可能会在一天内完成多次轮转，这在跨大西洋航线上是不可能的。较短航线的飞机可用性高有助于提高相关的高频次。

title_en: Heathrow Sparks Fury As Delta Forced To Move From Shared Virgin Atlantic Terminal
title_zh: 达美航空被迫从共享的维珍航空航站楼迁出希思罗机场引发愤怒
summary: Heathrow's decision to separate Delta and Virgin Atlantic sparks competition concerns and potential legal challenges.
summary_zh: 希思罗机场将达美航空和维珍航空分开的决定引发了竞争担忧和潜在的法律挑战。
body_en: Heathrow Sparks Fury As Delta Forced To Move From Shared Virgin Atlantic Terminal

Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

London Heathrow Airport (LHR) has sparked a furious response from Virgin Atlantic after ordering joint venture partner Delta Air Lines to relocate from Terminal 3 to Terminal 4 in 2028. Sky News reports that the decision follows a major review of terminal occupancy , with Virgin warning that separating the airlines could increase fares and undermine competition.

The two carriers have shared Terminal 3 since 2016, building an integrated transatlantic operation offering convenient connections and premium facilities. Meanwhile, British Airways and American Airlines benefit from substantial co-location at Terminal 5, raising questions about whether Heathrow's decision creates an uneven competitive playing field.

Heathrow's terminals accommodate several competing alliances. British Airways and American Airlines primarily operate from Terminal 5 (although American does also operate from Terminal 3), while Virgin and Delta have shared Terminal 3 for the past decade. Interestingly, the bulk of fellow SkyTeam members, such as Air France and KLM , operate from Terminal 4. So the move is interesting as it clearly disrupts the Virgin-Delta partnership , but yet places Delta with a wider array of alliance partners.

The immediate impact of moving Delta is that it would complicate connections, potentially increasing transfer times and requiring additional security screening. It would also disrupt the extensive shared check-in and screening facilities at Terminal 3, while premium passengers would lose convenient access to Virgin's Terminal 3 Clubhouse, Upper Class Wing, and Revivals Lounge. While alternatives for Delta passengers exist at Terminal 4 — notably the new Air France lounge and the SkyTeam Plaza Premium Lounge — it certainly narrows the choices for Delta passengers.

Virgin CEO Corneel Koster was quick to attack the move, warning that separating the airlines would weaken their joint venture, thereby putting a finger on the scale of competition with the British Airways-American Airlines joint venture, and ultimately harming consumers

"If implemented in 2028, Heathrow's decision to separate Delta Air Lines from Virgin Atlantic would create friction for customers, weaken competition, and reduce choice. As all other airports seek to co-locate joint venture partners, Heathrow has chosen to split ours after more than a decade together."

Heathrow holds a different view. The airport maintains that its proposals will improve capacity, reduce congestion, and accommodate growth, all vital ingredients for the future success of one of the world's busiest hubs. A Heathrow spokesperson told Sky News
"As demand at Heathrow continues to grow, these small number of moves will unlock more capacity across terminals, reduce congestion, improve the flow of passengers, and help keep costs down."

Heathrow maintains that airlines representing 81% of passengers support the plan. However, given that the BA-AA joint venture represents nearly 70% of all Heathrow-US traffic, it is hardly surprising that it would come out in support of a change that is damaging to its largest competitor. As a result, a source speaking to Sky News described the move as "one monopoly reinforcing another monopoly."

There is also a historical irony. Heathrow's previous occupancy review in 2014 concluded that Delta could move from Terminal 4 and consolidate with Virgin in Terminal 3, a process that it completed in September 2016. Both the airport and the airlines explicitly celebrated the operational advantages at the time, making the proposed reversal particularly controversial.

Nevertheless, Heathrow must balance the requirements of approximately 80 airlines operating within constrained infrastructure. Its argument centers on airport-wide efficiency rather than individual partnerships. Whether those benefits outweigh the inconvenience imposed on Virgin and Delta passengers remains disputed, particularly given Heathrow's limited capacity and continuing expansion challenges.

Virgin has made it clear that it intends to challenge the decision. Koster says it is considering "all available options," which would potentially involve the Civil Aviation Authority (CAA), Competition and Markets Authority (CMA), or the courts. He said

"A level playing field for UK-based carriers and their partners is vital for consumers and the UK economy. Given Heathrow's significant market power, and the expected impact on UK long-haul competition, we will consider all available options to challenge this outcome."

There is precedent for regulatory disputes, and Virgin and Delta appealed Heathrow's airport charges in 2023. However, those proceedings concerned pricing rather than terminal allocation, meaning no equivalent automatic appeal mechanism has been established. Negotiation likely offers the first and most practical solution. Virgin could seek to retain Delta at Terminal 3, move alongside it to Terminal 4, or negotiate improved transfers and replacement lounge access.

Delta has yet to comment publicly on the decision, although it is likely to share Virgin Atlantic's frustration at the prospect of dismantling more than a decade of close cooperation at Heathrow. With the relocation not scheduled until 2028, however, the partners have time to challenge the decision, negotiate a compromise or develop alternative arrangements. Given the commercial stakes and Virgin's determination to fight the move, this dispute looks far from over.
body_zh: 达美航空被迫从共享的维珍航空航站楼迁出希思罗机场引发愤怒
Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍布 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 在命令合资伙伴达美航空于 2028 年从 3 号航站楼迁至 4 号航站楼后，引发了维珍航空的强烈反应。天空新闻报道称，这一决定是在对航站楼占用率进行重大审查后作出的，维珍警告称，分离航空公司可能会增加票价并破坏竞争。
两家航空公司自 2016 年起共用 3 号航站楼，打造跨大西洋一体化运营，提供便捷的转机和优质的设施。与此同时，英国航空和美国航空受益于 5 号航站楼的大量同地办公，这引发了人们对希思罗机场的决定是否会造成不公平竞争环境的质疑。
希思罗机场的航站楼容纳了多个相互竞争的联盟。英国航空和美国航空主要在 5 号航站楼运营（尽管美国航空也在 3 号航站楼运营），而维珍航空和达美航空在过去十年中共用 3 号航站楼。有趣的是，大多数天合联盟成员，例如法国航空和荷兰皇家航空，都在 4 号航站楼运营。因此，这一举措很有趣，因为它显然破坏了维珍与达美的合作关系，但同时也让达美有了更广泛的联盟合作伙伴。
达美航空搬迁的直接影响是，它会使转机变得复杂，可能会增加转机时间，并需要额外的安全检查。它还将扰乱 3 号航站楼广泛的共享值机和安检设施，而高级乘客将无法方便地进入维珍 3 号航站楼俱乐部会所、Upper Class Wing 和 Revivals 休息室。虽然 4 号航站楼为达美航空乘客提供了其他选择，尤其是新的法航休息室和天合联盟广场高级休息室，但这无疑缩小了达美航空乘客的选择范围。
维珍航空首席执行官科尼尔·科斯特(Corneel Koster)很快对这一举动提出了批评，警告称，拆分两家航空公司将削弱其合资企业的实力，从而影响与英国航空-美国航空合资企业的竞争规模，最终损害消费者的利益。
“如果希思罗机场将达美航空与维珍航空分拆的决定在 2028 年实施，将会给客户带来摩擦，削弱竞争，并减少选择。当所有其他机场都寻求与合资伙伴共处一地时，希思罗机场在合作十多年后选择将我们的机场分拆。”
希思罗机场持有不同的观点。该机场坚称其建议将提高容量、减少拥堵并适应增长，这些都是世界上最繁忙的枢纽之一未来成功的重要因素。希思罗机场发言人告诉天空新闻
“随着希思罗机场的需求持续增长，这些少量的搬迁将释放更多航站楼的容量，减少拥堵，改善客流量，并有助于降低成本。”
希思罗机场坚称，代表 81% 乘客的航空公司支持该计划。然而，鉴于 BA-AA 合资企业占希思罗机场至美国所有交通量的近 70%，因此它支持一项对其最大竞争对手造成损害的变革也就不足为奇了。因此，一位接受天空新闻采访的消息人士将此举描述为“一个垄断强化了另一个垄断”。
这其中还有一个历史的讽刺。希思罗机场 2014 年的上一次占用审查得出的结论是，达美航空可以从 4 号航站楼迁出，并在 3 号航站楼与维珍航空合并，这一过程于 2016 年 9 月完成。机场和航空公司当时都明确赞扬了运营优势，这使得拟议的逆转特别有争议。
尽管如此，希思罗机场必须平衡大约 80 家在基础设施有限的情况下运营的航空公司的需求。它的论点集中在整个机场的效率而不是个体合作伙伴关系。这些好处是否超过维珍航空和达美航空乘客带来的不便仍然存在争议，特别是考虑到希思罗机场的运力有限和持续的扩张挑战。
维珍航空已明确表示打算对这一决定提出质疑。科斯特表示，它正在考虑“所有可用的选择”，其中可能涉及民航局（CAA）、竞争与市场管理局（CMA）或法院。他说
“英国航空公司及其合作伙伴的公平竞争环境对于消费者和英国经济至关重要。鉴于希思罗机场的巨大市场力量以及对英国长途竞争的预期影响，我们将考虑所有可用的选择来挑战这一结果。”
监管纠纷已有先例，维珍和达美曾于2023年对希思罗机场收费提出上诉。不过，这些诉讼涉及的是定价而非航站楼分配，这意味着尚未建立同等的自动上诉机制。谈判可能提供第一个也是最实际的解决方案。维珍可能会寻求将达美航空保留在 3 号航站楼，并与它一起迁至 4 号航站楼，或者协商改进转机和更换休息室使用权。
达美航空尚未就这一决定公开发表评论，尽管它很可能和维珍航空一样，对希思罗机场十多年的密切合作关系被解除感到沮丧。然而，由于搬迁计划要到 2028 年才能完成，因此合作伙伴有时间质疑这一决定、协商妥协或制定替代安排。考虑到商业利益和维珍抵制此举的决心，这场争端看起来还远未结束。

title_en: Delta One Business Class Award Sale: These Deals Are Worth A Look!
title_zh: 达美一号商务舱奖励促销：这些优惠值得一看！
summary: Delta is running a three-day Delta One award sale for bookings October 27–29, 2026, with prices from 115K miles. Some deals are decent, but plenty of others aren't.
summary_zh: 达美航空将针对 2026 年 10 月 27 日至 29 日期间的预订开展为期三天的达美一号奖励促销活动，价格从 115,000 英里起。有些优惠还不错，但也有很多
body_en: Delta SkyMiles is having a limited time Delta One (business class) award sale. While I can’t say that the “sale” price of 795K miles roundtrip from Miami to Tokyo is speaking to me, there are some semi-decent deals here, if you do happen to have SkyMiles.
Delta One three-day award sale, starting at 115K miles

If you’ve ever redeemed Delta SkyMiles , you probably know how inflated premium cabin award rates generally are. Occasionally Delta SkyMiles has an award sale, which brings the lowest business class redemption rates from offensively outrageous to just slightly high. 😉

Delta SkyMiles has just launched a three-day Delta One award sale , valid for bookings between October 27 and October 29, 2026. The deals differ significantly based on where you’re originating, but you can go to this page , enter the origin, and then see what is available.

With this sale, roundtrip award prices are being marketed, but one-ways are generally available for half the cost of a roundtrip. Travel windows vary by route, but travel is generally valid either in late 2026 or early 2027, during a really narrow travel window. Some of the prices are actually reasonably attractive…

Keep in mind that all of these redemption rates are before the 15% discount that Delta Amex cardmembers can receive. I absolutely wouldn’t transfer any Amex Membership Rewards points to Delta to take advantage of this deal, but if you have any SkyMiles already, this could be a good way to use it.
If you are going to fly Delta One business class , be strategic about which planes you book , as the quality differs greatly between aircraft.

Here’s the thing — Delta SkyMiles aren’t useless, they’re just valuable in different ways than other currencies. On the plus side, the miles have a pretty high floor value, which is to say that you can efficiently redeem them toward economy seats on most flights where the cash fares are reasonable.

However, Delta seems to intentionally have high business class award pricing on long haul flights, because the airline wants to condition people to think of SkyMiles as a revenue based program, and wants people to think of business class as something you pay top dollar for.

If you want to get the best deal possible redeeming SkyMiles for first and business class, the key is for travel to not originate or terminate in the United States. Award pricing is much more attractive when traveling between other regions.

Delta SkyMiles currently has an award sale, offering discounted Delta One redemptions. There are some attractive deals to be had, especially compared to what Delta would usually charge. Some long haul Delta One awards cost 115K miles, so if you take 15% off that (from being a cardmember), you’re looking at a cost of just under 100K miles one-way, which is actually decent.
What’s your take on this Delta One award sale?

title_en: COOL: Alaska Adds Anchorage To Tokyo Narita Flights, With Boeing 737 MAX!
title_zh: 酷：阿拉斯加在东京成田航班中增加安克雷奇，使用波音 737 MAX！
summary: Alaska Airlines will fly daily between Anchorage and Tokyo Narita from May 13 to September 7, 2027, using a Boeing 737 MAX 8 on the 3,434-mile route.
summary_zh: 阿拉斯加航空将于 2027 年 5 月 13 日至 9 月 7 日每天在安克雷奇和东京成田之间运营，使用波音 737 MAX 8 飞机，航线全长 3,434 英里。
body_en: Alaska Airlines will connect Alaska and Japan! I don’t care that this flight is operated by a Boeing 737, this is easily the coolest new route we’ve seen announced by a US carrier since United added flights to Greenland and Mongolia .
Alaska launching Anchorage to Tokyo Narita flights as of May 2027
Between May 13 and September 7, 2027, Alaska intends to operate daily nonstop flights between Anchorage (ANC) and Tokyo Narita (NRT), with the following schedule
AS21 Anchorage to Tokyo Narita departing 2:10PM arriving 3:25PM (+1 day)
AS22 Tokyo Narita to Anchorage departing 9:45PM arriving 12:00PM

The 3,434-mile flight is blocked at 8hr15min westbound and 7hr15min eastbound. It’ll be operated by a Boeing 737 MAX 8, featuring 161 seats, including 16 first class seats and 145 economy seats. This will be Alaska’s second-longest Boeing 737 MAX route ever, as the airline also operated the plane this past summer from Seattle (SEA) to Keflavik (KEF) , and that covers 3,622 miles.
This is an absurdly cool new route, and a throwback!

Anchorage has an absolutely massive amount of transpacific capacity… if you’re a crate. For us humans, there has been no service for a long time, while there are dozens of flights per day from Anchorage to Asia, given what a big cargo hub the airport is.

While Alaska has never flown nonstop between Anchorage and Japan, the airline did fly from Anchorage to a handful of destinations in Eastern Russia between 1991 and 1998. When it comes to passenger service between Anchorage and Asia, more recently we’ve seen regularly scheduled flights to Taipei (TPE) on China Airlines, but that route ceased in 2011.

I’m not sure if we want to call this service “regular,” but up until 2019, Yakutia Airlines operated a once weekly flight between Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky (PKC) to Anchorage. I’m so bummed I never had the chance to fly that, since the airline had such a cool-looking Boeing 737 business class, with one row of recliner seats.

At one point New Pacific Airlines (initially known as Northern Pacific) was going to use Anchorage as a hub for operating transpacific flights, but unsurprisingly, that airline ultimately went out of business .

It goes without saying that spending this long on a Boeing 737 MAX is hardly glamorous. But let’s also be practical here — if you were trying to get between Alaska and Japan, you’d otherwise have to backtrack through somewhere like Seattle (SEA) or Vancouver (YVR), and it would more than double your travel time, and nearly double your travel distance.

A 737 MAX has low costs, and I imagine there will be a decent amount of demand in both directions, both among Alaskans looking to visit Asia, plus Japanese visitors (and others) wanting to visit Alaska. This is an absurdly cool new route, and I’d love to fly this!

Alaska Airlines’ newest transpacific route is with a narrow body, as we’ll see the airline fly daily between Anchorage and Tokyo Narita in the summer of 2027. The route will be operated by a Boeing 737 MAX, which is hardly comfortable, but it’s the perfect plane for this kind of a flight.

The plane has the range, and ultimately this is a route people will book because it’s by far the most convenient way to get between Alaska and Asia, and not because of the amazing onboard product, or anything.
What do you make of Alaska launching Anchorage to Narita flights?
body_zh: 阿拉斯加航空将连接阿拉斯加和日本！我不在乎这趟航班是由波音 737 运营的，这无疑是自美联航增加飞往格陵兰和蒙古的航班以来美国航空公司宣布的最酷的新航线。
阿拉斯加从 2027 年 5 月起开通安克雷奇飞往东京成田的航班
2027 年 5 月 13 日至 9 月 7 日期间，阿拉斯加计划运营安克雷奇 (ANC) 和东京成田 (NRT) 之间的每日直飞航班，时间表如下
AS21 安克雷奇 飞往 东京成田 出发 下午 2:10 到达 下午 3:25（+1 天）
AS22 东京成田 至 安克雷奇 出发时间 9:45PM 到达 12:00PM
这趟全长 3,434 英里的航班在西行 8 小时 15 分钟和东行 7 小时 15 分钟受阻。该航班将由波音 737 MAX 8 运营，拥有 161 个座位，其中包括 16 个头等舱座位和 145 个经济舱座位。这将是阿拉斯加有史以来第二长的波音 737 MAX 航线，该航空公司去年夏天还运营了这架飞机从西雅图 (SEA) 飞往凯夫拉维克 (KEF) 的航线，航线全长 3,622 英里。
这是一条非常酷的新路线，而且是一种复古！
安克雷奇拥有绝对巨大的跨太平洋运力……如果你是一个板条箱的话。对于我们人类来说，已经很长时间没有服务了，而考虑到机场是一个大型货运枢纽，每天有数十个航班从安克雷奇飞往亚洲。
虽然阿拉斯加航空从未有过安克雷奇和日本之间的直飞航班，但该航空公司在 1991 年至 1998 年间确实有从安克雷奇飞往俄罗斯东部的几个目的地的航班。说到安克雷奇和亚洲之间的客运服务，最近我们看到中华航空有飞往台北 (TPE) 的定期航班，但该航线已于 2011 年停飞。
我不确定我们是否想将这项服务称为“常规”服务，但直到 2019 年，雅库特航空每周运营一趟堪察加彼得巴甫洛夫斯克 (PKC) 和安克雷奇之间的航班。我很遗憾自己从来没有机会坐过那趟飞机，因为该航空公司有一架看起来很酷的波音 737 商务舱，有一排躺椅。
新太平洋航空​​公司（最初称为北太平洋航空​​公司）曾一度打算使用安克雷奇作为运营跨太平洋航班的枢纽，但不出所料，该航空公司最终倒闭了。
不用说，在波音 737 MAX 上花费这么长时间并不光彩。但我们也要实际一点 - 如果您想在阿拉斯加和日本之间往返，则必须原路返回西雅图 (SEA) 或温哥华 (YVR) 等地，这将使您的旅行时间增加一倍以上，旅行距离也几乎增加一倍。
737 MAX 成本低廉，我想双向都会有相当大的需求，无论是想要访问亚洲的阿拉斯加人，还是想要访问阿拉斯加的日本游客（和其他人）。这是一条非常酷的新航线，我很想飞这条航线！
阿拉斯加航空最新的跨太平洋航线是窄体航线，我们将在 2027 年夏天看到该航空公司每天在安克雷奇和东京成田之间飞行。该航线将由波音 737 MAX 运营，虽然不太舒服，但它是此类航班的完美飞机。
这架飞机的航程很远，最终人们会预订这条航线，因为它是迄今为止往返阿拉斯加和亚洲最便捷的方式，而不是因为令人惊叹的机上产品或其他任何东西。
您如何看待阿拉斯加开通安克雷奇飞往成田的航班？

title_en: Heathrow Airport Terminal Shake-Up: Delta & Virgin Atlantic Are The Losers
title_zh: 希思罗机场航站楼改组：达美航空和维珍航空是输家
summary: Heathrow has revealed the results of its terminal occupancy review: five airlines will switch terminals in 2028, and Delta's move to Terminal 4 splits it from Virgin Atlantic.
summary_zh: 希思罗机场公布航站楼占用审查结果：2028年五家航空公司将更换航站楼 达美迁往4号航站楼分裂
body_en: Over the past couple of years, the operators of London Heathrow Airport (LHR) have been conducting a terminal occupancy review, which impacts which airlines operate out of which terminals. The results are now in, and five airlines will have to change terminals in 2028. The big losers here are Delta and Virgin Atlantic. Let’s talk a bit about the concept behind this review, and then discuss the results…
Why Heathrow conducts terminal occupancy reviews
First for some context, here’s how a spokesperson for Heathrow Airport describes the concept behind these terminal occupancy reviews

“Occupancy reviews are a normal part of running the airport – it’s how we ensure we make best use of the space that we have. We undertake these reviews usually once a decade to accommodate for changes in airline operations and airport infrastructure – the last review was in 2014 to coincide with the opening of Terminal 2.”

“The objective in these reviews is to make the best use of the limited space at Heathrow, particularly focusing on driving overall operational resilience and matching available capacity with demand – this enables us to protect passenger experience of travelling through the airport.”

Heathrow is one of the busiest airports in the world, and is heavily capacity constrained. The intent with any sort of a review is to distribute traffic throughout terminals as much as possible, so that there’s an efficient, steady flow of passengers. The goal is also to streamline connections as much as possible. Airline partnerships and strategies change all the time, so terminal allocations are intended to reflect that.

Admittedly Heathrow is capped in terms of its growth, given the airport’s valuable slot system. Currently Heathrow’s capacity constraints aren’t limitations on terminal traffic, but rather, on takeoffs and landings. While there are once again discussions about Heathrow getting a third runway , it’s anyone’s guess if it happens. Even if it does move forward, the project would be complete in 2039 at the absolute earliest.
As a basic recap of the current terminal situation at Heathrow (in order of traffic levels)
Terminal 5 is home to British Airways, and is the airport’s busiest terminal

Terminal 3 is home to Virgin Atlantic, Delta, Emirates, most oneworld airlines (and even some British Airways flights operate from there), among other airlines, and is the airport’s second busiest terminal
Terminal 2 is home to most Star Alliance airlines, as well as select independent carriers, like Aer Lingus, and is the airport’s third busiest terminal

Terminal 4 is home to many independent airlines (EL AL, Etihad, Kuwait Airways, WestJet, etc.), plus select oneworld airlines (Malaysia Airlines, Royal Air Maroc, Qatar Airways, etc.) and SkyTeam airlines (Air France-KLM, Korean Air, Saudia, etc.), and it’s the airport’s least busy terminal
Five airlines will have to change terminals at Heathrow

Heathrow Airport has just revealed the results from its latest terminal occupancy analysis, and the expectation is that these changes will take place in 2028. Specifically, five airlines will have to change terminals, as follows
Delta, Finnair, and Japan Airlines, will move from Terminal 3 to Terminal 4
China Southern will move from Terminal 4 to Terminal 5
LATAM will move from Terminal 3 to Terminal 2

In total, these airlines account for nearly two million passengers per year, and represent under 4% of traffic at Heathrow. Unsurprisingly, the goal here is largely to move airlines out of Terminal 3, given that it’s the second busiest terminal, and has a lot of peak hour traffic.
British Airways and China Southern have a joint venture, so them being able to co-locate at Terminal 5 is a positive for passengers
LATAM doesn’t have a huge presence at the airport, so I don’t think a move to Terminal 2 is a huge deal
body_zh: 在过去的几年里，伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 的运营商一直在进行航站楼占用率审查，这会影响哪些航空公司在哪些航站楼运营。结果现已公布，五家航空公司将不得不在 2028 年更换航站楼。最大的输家是达美航空和维珍航空。让我们谈谈这次审查背后的概念，然后讨论结果......
希思罗机场为何进行航站楼占用率审查
首先了解一些背景信息，以下是希思罗机场发言人如何描述这些航站楼入住率评论背后的概念
“占用率审查是机场运营的正常组成部分 - 这是我们确保充分利用现有空间的方式。我们通常每十年进行一次这些审查，以适应航空公司运营和机场基础设施的变化 - 最近一次审查是在 2014 年，恰逢 2 号航站楼开放。”
“这些审查的目标是充分利用希思罗机场的有限空间，特别是注重提高整体运营弹性并将可用容量与需求相匹配——这使我们能够保护旅客在机场旅行的体验。”
希思罗机场是世界上最繁忙的机场之一，但容量严重受限。任何形式的审查的目的都是尽可能地分配整个航站楼的客流量，从而实现高效、稳定的客流。目标还在于尽可能简化连接。航空公司的合作伙伴关系和战略一直在变化，因此航站楼分配旨在反映这一点。
诚然，考虑到机场宝贵的起降时刻系统，希思罗机场的增长受到了限制。目前希思罗机场的运力限制不是对航站楼交通的限制，而是对起飞和降落的限制。虽然人们再次讨论希思罗机场获得第三条跑道，但任何人都在猜测这是否会发生。即使确实向前推进，该项目最早也将在 2039 年完成。
对希思罗机场当前航站楼情况的基本回顾（按客流量水平排序）
5 号航站楼是英国航空的所在地，也是机场最繁忙的航站楼
3 号航站楼是维珍航空、达美航空、阿联酋航空、大多数寰宇一家航空公司（甚至一些英国航空的航班从这里运营）等航空公司的所在地，也是机场第二繁忙的航站楼
2 号航站楼是大多数星空联盟航空公司以及爱尔兰航空等精选独立航空公司的所在地，也是机场第三繁忙的航站楼
4 号航站楼是许多独立航空公司（以色列航空、阿提哈德航空、科威特航空、西捷航空等）以及精选寰宇一家航空公司（马来西亚航空、摩洛哥皇家航空、卡塔尔航空等）和天合联盟航空公司（法航荷航、大韩航空、沙特阿拉伯航空等）的基地，也是机场最不繁忙的航站楼
五家航空公司将不得不更换希思罗机场的航站楼
希思罗机场刚刚公布了最新的航站楼占用率分析结果，预计这些变化将在 2028 年发生。具体来说，有 5 家航空公司将不得不更换航站楼，具体如下
达美航空、芬兰航空和日本航空将从 3 号航站楼迁至 4 号航站楼
南航将从4号航站楼搬迁至5号航站楼
LATAM 将从 3 号航站楼迁至 2 号航站楼
这些航空公司每年总共运送近 200 万名旅客，占希思罗机场客流量的不到 4%。毫不奇怪，这里的目标主要是将航空公司迁出 3 号航站楼，因为它是第二繁忙的航站楼，并且高峰时段客流量很大。
英国航空和中国南方航空是一家合资企业，因此它们能够在 5 号航站楼共用对乘客来说是一个积极的因素
拉丁美洲在机场的影响力并不大，所以我认为搬到 2 号航站楼并不是什么大事

title_en: Buy Alaska Atmos Rewards Points With 90% Bonus (1.98 Cents Each): Worth It?
title_zh: 购买 Alaska Atmos 奖励积分可享受 90% 奖励（每个 1.98 美分）：值得吗？
summary: Atmos Rewards is offering up to a 90% bonus on purchased points through November 7, 2026, which works out to 1.98 cents each. Here's when buying makes sense.
summary_zh: Atmos Rewards 在 2026 年 11 月 7 日之前为购买的积分提供高达 90% 的奖励，相当于每个积分 1.98 美分。这是购买时的品牌
body_en: Atmos Rewards, the loyalty program of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines, is currently offering a promotion on purchased points . Through November 7, 2026, you can buy points at a discount, and this has the potential to be a great deal.

There’s value to be had here, whether you want to redeem for domestic awards on Alaska, Hawaiian, or American, in economy or business class, or redeem for long haul, premium cabin awards. Let’s go over all the details, and talk about under what circumstances it makes sense to buy Atmos Rewards points. As always, you should only buy points if you’ve crunched the numbers for yourself.
Link: Buy Alaska Atmos Rewards points with a bonus
Promotion on purchased Alaska Atmos Rewards points

Between 6AM PT on October 27 and 11:59PM PT on November 7, 2026, the Alaska Atmos Rewards program is offering a bonus on purchased points . Different members may be eligible for different offers. The version of the promotion I see on my account is for a bonus of up to 90%, structured as follows

Of course you’ll want to check your account to see what you’re eligible for, as it’s possible that some people may be targeted for better (or worse) offers. We also sometimes see the program offer 100% bonuses, or even 110% bonuses, so each member has to see what they’re eligible for.
How much does it cost to buy Alaska Atmos Rewards points?

Ordinarily you can buy Alaska Atmos Rewards points for 3.5 cents each pre-tax, before any discounts or bonuses. That price is before the 7.5% federal excise tax, which brings the non-bonused cost to 3.76 cents.

If you were eligible for the 90% bonus and purchased 100,000 Atmos Rewards points pre-bonus, you’d receive a total of 190,000 Atmos Rewards points at a cost of $3,762.50 including taxes, which is a rate of 1.98 cents per Atmos Rewards point.

Let me emphasize that if you were eligible for a 100% bonus, that would bring the cost down to 1.88 cents per point. Meanwhile if you were eligible for a 110% bonus, that would bring the cost down to 1.79 cents per point.
How many Atmos Rewards points can you purchase?
The number of Atmos Rewards points you can buy depends on your status
Alaska Atmos Rewards elite members can purchase an unlimited number of points

Alaska Atmos Rewards non-elite members can ordinarily purchase up to 150,000 points per calendar year, and that limit doesn’t include the bonus points; however, during this promotion, that cap has been increased to 250,000 points

Note that in all cases you’re limited to purchasing 100,000 Atmos Rewards points per transaction (pre-bonus), though you can always make multiple transactions. Furthermore, you can only purchase points if you’ve been a member of Atmos Rewards for at least 10 days.

If you do buy Atmos rewards points, points typically post to your account instantly, the purchase is non-refundable, and the points earned this way don’t count toward elite status (though as I’ll explain below, when you redeem the points, that can count toward status).
How does this compare to other Atmos Rewards buy points promotions?

When Atmos Rewards offers a promotion on purchased points, it’s common to see a 90-100% bonus, so this is in line with those offers. Personally, I’d recommend buying points based on when you have a short term use in mind, rather than based on the slight difference in the cost per point.

title_en: Boeing Q3 2026 results: record backlog, 737-7 and 737-10 certified, loss narrows
title_zh: 波音 2026 年第三季度业绩：积压创纪录，737-7 和 737-10 获得认证，亏损收窄
summary: Boeing closed the third quarter of 2026 with a record backlog, two newly certified 737 MAX variants and… The post Boeing Q3 2026 results: record backlog, 737-7 and 737-10 certified, loss narrows appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 波音公司以创纪录的积压量结束了 2026 年第三季度，两架新认证的 737 MAX 型号以及……波音 2026 年第三季度业绩：创纪录的积压量
body_en: Boeing closed the third quarter of 2026 with a record backlog, two newly certified 737 MAX variants and a major new fighter contract, but remained slightly in the red, according to financial results published on October 27, 2026.

Boeing’s revenue for the quarter rose 4% year-on-year to $24.2 billion, driven mainly by stronger performance in its defense and services businesses. The company reported a net loss of $116 million, a sharp improvement on the $5.3 billion loss a year earlier, when results were hit by a large charge on the 777X program.
Operating cash flow came in at $1.5 billion and free cash flow at $0.5 billion. That was despite payments of about $0.7 billion linked to Boeing’s settlement with the US Department of Justice.
The company ended the quarter with $20.7 billion in cash and investments, while its debt stayed at $45.9 billion. Boeing’s total backlog grew to a record $745 billion.

“Recent milestones, including certification of the 737-7 and 737-10 and selection to design and build the Navy’s sixth-generation fighter aircraft, are important steps as we continue building on our progress,” said Kelly Ortberg, Boeing’s President and Chief Executive Officer. “But we are not done.”
He added that the company remains “focused on safety and quality” as it works to “build the durable performance our stakeholders expect.”

Boeing delivered 161 commercial airplanes in the third quarter, one more than a year earlier, bringing its total for the first nine months of 2026 to 475. Most of those were 737s, with 124 handed over in the quarter.

The quarter’s biggest commercial milestone was certification of the two remaining 737 MAX variants. The 737-7 received amended type certification from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) during the quarter, and the 737-10 followed in October 2026.

The 737 program is working toward a stable production rate of 47 aircraft per month, while the 787 program remains steady at eight per month. On the 777X, certification flight testing of the 777-9 continued, and Boeing says the aircraft remains on track for first delivery in 2027.

Despite the progress, the Commercial Airplanes unit remained loss-making, with an operating loss of $697 million on revenue of $10.7 billion. Boeing attributed this to a less favorable mix of aircraft deliveries, higher projected costs tied to future production rate adjustments and rising supply chain costs.

Orders remained strong. Boeing booked 300 net orders in the quarter, including from Turkish Airlines, Ethiopian Airlines and Lufthansa. Its commercial backlog now stands at more than 6,300 airplanes, worth a record $612 billion.
Boeing’s Defense, Space & Security division had a stronger quarter.

Revenue rose 15% to $7.9 billion, and operating earnings more than quadrupled to $492 million. The result was helped by a $252 million gain from the sale of HRL Laboratories and by improved operational performance.

During the quarter, the US Navy selected Boeing to design, build and deliver its F/A-XX next-generation fighter aircraft. The contract has not yet been added to the backlog while the source selection and evaluation review is completed.

Boeing also received a seven-year contract to expand production of the PAC-3 missile seeker. The division’s backlog reached a record $101 billion, with 23% of orders coming from customers outside the United States.
Boeing Global Services continued to be the company’s most profitable unit. Revenue grew 4% to $5.6 billion, with an operating margin of 18.3%, reflecting higher volume and a favorable business mix.
The unit won a US Army contract to maintain the AH-64 Apache fleet and ended the quarter with a $33 billion backlog.

With both remaining 737 MAX variants now certified, the 777X moving toward first delivery and a record backlog across all three businesses, Boeing heads into the final quarter of 2026 with momentum, although its commercial airplane division has yet to return to profitability.
The post Boeing Q3 2026 results: record backlog, 737-7 and 737-10 certified, loss narrows appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 根据 2026 年 10 月 27 日发布的财务业绩，波音公司以创纪录的积压订单、两架新认证的 737 MAX 型号和一份重要的新战斗机合同结束了 2026 年第三季度，但仍略有亏损。
波音公司本季度收入同比增长 4% 至 242 亿美元，主要得益于其国防和服务业务的强劲表现。该公司公布净亏损 1.16 亿美元，较上年同期的 53 亿美元亏损大幅改善，当时业绩因 777X 项目的巨额费用而受到打击。
运营现金流为 15 亿美元，自由现金流为 5 亿美元。尽管波音公司与美国司法部达成和解，但支付了约 7 亿美元。
该公司截至本季度末的现金和投资为 207 亿美元，而债务仍保持在 459 亿美元。波音公司的积压订单总额增至创纪录的 7,450 亿美元。
波音公司总裁兼首席执行官凯利·奥特伯格表示：“最近的里程碑，包括 737-7 和 737-10 的认证以及选择设计和建造海军第六代战斗机，是我们继续取得进展的重要步骤。” “但我们还没有完成。”
他补充说，该公司仍然“专注于安全和质量”，因为它致力于“建立利益相关者期望的持久绩效”。
波音公司第三季度交付了 161 架商用飞机，比去年同期增加了 1 架，使 2026 年前 9 个月的商用飞机总数达到 475 架。其中大部分是 737 飞机，本季度交付了 124 架。
本季度最大的商业里程碑是剩余两架 737 MAX 型号的认证。 737-7 在本季度获得了美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的修订型号认证，737-10 也于 2026 年 10 月获得了修订后的型号认证。
737 项目正努力实现每月 47 架飞机的稳定生产率，而 787 项目则保持稳定在每月 8 架。对于 777X，777-9 的认证飞行测试仍在继续，波音表示该飞机仍有望于 2027 年首次交付。
尽管取得了进展，商用飞机部门仍处于亏损状态，营业亏损 6.97 亿美元，收入 107 亿美元。波音公司将此归因于飞机交付组合较差、与未来生产率调整相关的预计成本较高以及供应链成本上升。
订单依然强劲。波音公司本季度获得了 300 份净订单，其中包括来自土耳其航空、埃塞俄比亚航空和汉莎航空的订单。目前，其商业积压飞机数量已超过 6,300 架，价值创纪录的 6,120 亿美元。
波音公司的国防、太空与安全部门的季度业绩表现强劲。
收入增长 15%，达到 79 亿美元，营业利润增长四倍多，达到 4.92 亿美元。这一结果得益于 HRL 实验室出售带来的 2.52 亿美元收益以及运营绩效的改善。
本季度，美国海军选择波音公司设计、制造和交付其 F/A-XX 下一代战斗机。来源选择和评估审核已完成，合同尚未添加到待办事项中。
波音公司还获得了一份为期七年的合同，以扩大 PAC-3 导弹导引头的生产。该部门的积压订单达到创纪录的 1010 亿美元，其中 23% 的订单来自美国以外的客户。
波音全球服务仍然是该公司最赚钱的部门。收入增长 4%，达到 56 亿美元，营业利润率为 18.3%，反映出更高的销量和有利的业务组合。
该单位赢得了美国陆军维护 AH-64 阿帕奇机队的合同，并在本季度结束时积压了 330 亿美元。
随着剩余的 737 MAX 型号现已获得认证，777X 正迈向首次交付，并且所有三个业务的积压订单均创历史新高，波音公司将充满动力地进入 2026 年最后一个季度，尽管其商用飞机部门尚未恢复盈利。

title_en: Bilt Program Changes For 2027 Impact Bilt Cash, Credit Cards, & Hotel Redemptions
title_zh: Bilt 计划变更 2027 年 Impact Bilt 现金、信用卡和酒店兑换
summary: Bilt has announced program changes for 2027, including a new default housing earning rate, a new Bilt Cash expiration policy, and limits on hotel redemptions. Here's what's changing.
summary_zh: Bilt 宣布了 2027 年的计划变更，包括新的默认住房收益率、新的 Bilt 现金到期政策以及酒店转租限制
body_en: Bilt is the program known for its lucrative credit card portfolio and rewards on housing payments . I’d say Bilt can be extremely worthwhile, though also really complicated, especially in light of the changes that we saw in early 2026 . Well, Bilt has now announced quite a few program updates for 2027.

Some are positive, some are negative, but I’d argue that the fundamental value proposition isn’t changing much here. If you liked the Bilt Blue Card ( learn more ), Bilt Obsidian Card ( learn more ), or Bilt Palladium Card ( learn more ) before, you probably won’t feel too different ( Rates & Fees ).
What’s changing with the Bilt program in 2027

Bilt has revealed changes to how members can earn points and rewards in 2027. There are quite a few updates here, so let’s just go through them — I’ll rank them roughly in order of importance, as I see it, starting with the most significant change.
Bilt Cash will no longer be earned by default as before

Currently, those with a Bilt credit card can earn 4% back on spending in the form of Bilt Cash , in addition to the points that they earn. Starting on your next card account anniversary, Bilt credit cards are being moved to what’s being described as a “simpler” set of benefits.

The most significant change is that by default, everyone will earn up to 1.25x Bilt Points on their rent or mortgage payment, as Bilt claims it’s simplifying the program and retiring Flexible Bilt Cash mode, which earns 4% back in Bilt Cash on everyday spend (in addition to points).
Just for context, below are the two options that members have had up until now.
That up to 1.25x points is tiered based on your monthly card spending, as you’ll see below.

Points on Housing Minimum everyday spend as a % of monthly rent / mortgage (Example of $2,000 rent) 0.5x points Spend at least 25% of monthly rent ($500) 0.75x points Spend at least 50% of monthly rent ($1,000) 1x points Spend at least 75% of monthly rent ($1,500) 1.25x points Spend the same or more as your monthly rent ($2,000)

But here’s the good news — cardmembers aren’t actually being forced to move from earning 4% Bilt Cash to earning up to 1.25x points on their housing payments. Instead, if you’d like, you can keep earning in Flexible Bilt Cash mode. If that’s your preference, you just have to opt out of the new benefits in your card settings before your card anniversary date, and then you’ll keep any eligible annual credits, and won’t be able to switch between Flexible Bilt Cash and housing-only mode.

New cardmembers will also have this option through December 31, 2026, though as of January 1, 2027, the 1.25x points will be the automatic earning rate. So for the time being, not a whole lot is actually changing here, except no more flexibility to switch between earning options month to month.
Beyond that, we’re seeing the following Bilt Cash changes
Bilt Palladium and Obsidian cardmembers will receive their annual Bilt Cash credits based on their account anniversary year, rather than at the beginning of the calendar year, on January 1

Bilt Palladium cardmembers will go from earning $200 Bilt Cash plus a $400 Bilt hotel credit annually, to just earning $600 in Bilt Cash annually, which can be used more flexibly; note that if you choose to still earn 4% Bilt Cash and have the card, you can still stack the $200 credit and $100 Bilt Cash for hotels
Bilt Obsidian cardholders will go from earning a $100 Bilt hotel credit annually, to earning $100 Bilt Cash annually

There are no changes to the points earning rates on the cards, and Bilt Palladium and Bilt Obsidian cardmembers will continue to have the ability to redeem Bilt Cash for Points Accelerator (whereby you can redeem $200 in Bilt Cash to earn an extra point per dollar spent, on up to $5,000 in spending, up to five times per year)
Bilt is giving members more time to redeem Bilt Cash. Up until now, Bilt Cash has expired at the end of the calendar year, with the ability for $100 in Bilt Cash to roll over to the following year.

With these changes, Bilt Cash now expires at the end of the month, 12 months after it’s earned. In other words, Bilt Cash earned in October 2026 would expire on October 31, 2027. This addresses a major point of frustration that many members have had.

Currently, Bilt members can redeem up to $1,200 per year in Bilt Cash toward Bilt travel portal hotel bookings, with a two-night minimum stay. The limit has been $50 per month for Blue and Silver members, and $100 per month for Gold and Platinum members.
body_zh: Bilt 计划以其利润丰厚的信用卡组合和住房支付奖励而闻名。我想说 Bilt 非常有价值，尽管也非常复杂，特别是考虑到我们在 2026 年初看到的变化。嗯，比尔特现在已经宣布了 2027 年的不少计划更新。
有些是积极的，有些是消极的，但我认为基本的价值主张在这里并没有太大变化。如果您之前喜欢 Bilt Blue 卡（了解更多）、Bilt Obsidian Card（了解更多）或 Bilt Palladium Card（了解更多），您可能不会觉得有太大不同（费率和费用）。
2027 年 Bilt 计划将发生哪些变化
Bilt 透露了 2027 年会员赚取积分和奖励方式的变化。这里有很多更新，所以让我们浏览一下它们 - 我将按照我认为的重要性顺序对它们进行粗略排名，从最重要的变化开始。
Bilt Cash 将不再像以前一样默认赚取
目前，持有 Bilt 信用卡的人除了赚取积分外，还可以以 Bilt Cash 的形式赚取 4% 的消费返还。从您的下一个卡帐户周年纪念日开始，Bilt 信用卡将被转移到所谓的“更简单”的福利组合中。
最显着的变化是，默认情况下，每个人在支付租金或抵押贷款时将获得高达 1.25 倍的 Bilt 积分，因为 Bilt 声称它正在简化计划并取消灵活的 Bilt 现金模式，该模式在日常支出（除积分外）中可赚取 4% 的 Bilt 现金返还。
仅供参考，以下是成员迄今为止所拥有的两个选项。
高达 1.25 倍的积分根据您每月的卡消费进行分级，如下所示。
住房积分 每日最低支出占月租金/抵押贷款的百分比（例如 $2,000 租金） 0.5x 积分 至少支出月租金的 25%（$500） 0.75x 积分 至少支出月租金的 50%（$1,000） 1x 积分 至少支出月租金的 75%（$1,500） 1.25x 积分 支出与每月相同或更多租金 ($2,000)
但好消息是，持卡会员实际上并没有被迫从赚取 4% Bilt Cash 转为赚取高达 1.25 倍的住房付款积分。相反，如果您愿意，您可以在灵活的 Bilt Cash 模式下继续赚取收入。如果这是您的偏好，您只需在卡周年日之前在卡设置中选择退出新福利，然后您将保留任何符合条件的年度积分，并且无法在灵活 Bilt 现金和仅限住房模式之间切换。
新持卡会员在 2026 年 12 月 31 日之前也可以选择此选项，但从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，1.25 倍积分将成为自动赚取率。因此，就目前而言，除了每月在收入选项之间切换不再灵活之外，实际上并没有发生太大变化。
除此之外，我们还看到了以下 Bilt Cash 变化
Bilt Palladium 和 Obsidian 持卡会员将根据其账户周年纪念年（而不是日历年年初的 1 月 1 日）收到年度 Bilt Cash 积分
Bilt Palladium持卡人将从每年赚取200美元Bilt Cash加400美元Bilt酒店积分，变为每年仅赚取600美元Bilt Cash，使用更加灵活；请注意，如果您选择仍然赚取 4% Bilt Cash 并拥有该卡，您仍然可以叠加 200 美元的积分和 100 美元 Bilt Cash 的酒店住宿
Bilt Obsidian 持卡人将从每年赚取 100 美元的 Bilt 酒店积分，变为每年赚取 100 美元的 Bilt 现金
卡上的积分赚取率没有变化，Bilt Palladium 和 Bilt Obsidian 持卡人将继续能够将 Bilt Cash 兑换为积分加速器（您可以兑换 200 美元的 Bilt Cash，每消费 1​​ 美元即可赚取额外积分，消费金额不超过 5,000 美元，每年最多 5 次）
Bilt 为会员提供了更多时间来兑换 Bilt Cash。到目前为止，Bilt Cash 已于日历年年底到期，100 美元的 Bilt Cash 可以结转到下一年。
经过这些变化，Bilt Cash 现在将于月底到期，也就是赚取后的 12 个月后。换句话说，2026 年 10 月赚取的 Bilt Cash 将于 2027 年 10 月 31 日到期。这解决了许多会员所遇到的一个主要问题。
目前，Bilt 会员每年最多可兑换 1,200 美元的 Bilt Cash，用于预订 Bilt 旅游门户酒店，且至少入住两晚。蓝卡和银卡会员的限额为每月 50 美元，金卡和白金卡会员的限额为每月 100 美元。

body_en: Citi and American Airlines have a co-branded credit card agreement, which includes five cards issued in the United States. It has just been announced that we’ll see changes to the mid-range personal and business cards — we’re talking the Citi AAdvantage Platinum Select World Elite Mastercard and the Citi AAdvantage Business World Elite Mastercard.

The cards are getting some new benefits, though the annual fees will also be increased. Let’s cover the details, and let me emphasize that there are no changes to the no annual fee Citi AAdvantage MileUp Card, or the premium Citi AAdvantage Globe Card and Citi AAdvantage Executive Card.
Citi AAdvantage Platinum Card changes: $150 fee, new benefits

Let’s start with the Citi AAdvantage Platinum Card, which has historically had a $99 annual fee, waived the first year. The card’s annual fee will be increasing to $150, though the card will also be getting all kinds of new benefits . Here are the new benefits being added to the Citi AAdvantage Platinum Card
3x miles on eligible AAdvantage Hotels and AAdvantage Cars bookings
2x miles at gas stations, now expanded to include EV charging stations
2x miles on eligible Rides and Rails purchases
$150 American Airlines Flight Discount, increased from $125, after spending $20,000 or more in purchases during the anniversary year and renewing the card
Up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee credit every four years
Up to $100 back in statement credits annually on inflight purchases
Complimentary annual Walmart+ membership ($98 in value) for primary cardmembers, offering free delivery ($35 minimum for scheduled delivery orders), gas savings, and video streaming choice
50% discount on an annual FOX One subscription
Travel protections, including trip delay protection, trip cancellation & interruption protection, worldwide car rental insurance, and lost baggage protection
These changes are in addition to the current Citi AAdvantage Platinum Card benefits, which include the following
2x miles on eligible American Airlines purchases
1x Loyalty Point for every mile earned from purchases
Up to $180 annually on Turo car rentals (up to $30 in statement credits for each eligible Turo car rental trip completed)
10% savings on eligible American Airlines Vacations travel packages
Preferred boarding on American Airlines flights for the primary cardmember and up to four companions traveling on the same reservation
First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for the primary cardmember and up to four companions traveling on the same reservation

summary: TransMedics has selected Gogo Galileo HDX connectivity to support time-critical transplant organs while conducting potentially life-saving flights across… The post TransMedics selects Galileo HDX to support time-critical organ delivery missions appeared first
summary_zh: TransMedics 选择 Gogo Galileo HDX 连接来支持时间紧迫的器官移植，同时进行可能挽救生命的飞行
body_en: TransMedics has selected Gogo Galileo HDX connectivity to support time-critical transplant organs while conducting potentially life-saving flights across the US.

TransMedics, an organ transplantation technology, services and logistics firm, operates a fleet of 22 Embraer Phenom 300E aircraft, which rely on “high-performance and high-speed inflight connectivity” to monitor organs during transit.
Under the new agreement, Galileo HDX is already being installed on all TransMedics’ aircraft, and the full fleet is expected to be equipped by 2027.
According to Gogo, during each mission, organs are continuously monitored in flight using TransMedics’ Organ Care System (OCS), making reliable connectivity central to operations.

“Every flight we operate carries the potential to save a life, which makes continuous, real-time visibility into each organ’s status during transport mission-critical,” Andre Costa, VP of Global Logistics at TransMedics, said. “We are proud to pioneer this initiative. By mid-2027, Gogo Galileo will be operating across our entire fleet, making TransMedics the first and only organ transplant company to achieve this milestone, and we plan to extend this capability to our European fleet in 2028.”

Costa added: “We selected Gogo Galileo not only for the reliable, high-performance connectivity these critical missions demand, but also for the cybersecurity, system redundancy, and active monitoring that Gogo delivers to its customers.”
Gogo Galileo is powered by Eutelsat OneWeb’s enterprise-grade low Earth orbit (LEO) network.

“Business aviation supports far more than executive travel: it enables critical missions that communities rely on every day,” said Chris Moore, CEO of Gogo. “TransMedics is a powerful example of that. When you’re transporting donor organs, connectivity isn’t a convenience; it’s part of the mission. “
The post TransMedics selects Galileo HDX to support time-critical organ delivery missions appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: TransMedics 选择了 Gogo Galileo HDX 连接来支持时间紧迫的器官移植，同时在美国各地进行可能挽救生命的飞行。
TransMedics 是一家器官移植技术、服务和物流公司，运营着一支由 22 架 Embraer Phenom 300E 飞机组成的机队，这些飞机依靠“高性能和高速机上连接”来监测运输过程中的器官。
根据新协议，Galileo HDX 已安装在 TransMedics 的所有飞机上，预计到 2027 年全部机队都将配备。
Gogo 表示，在每次任务期间，使用 TransMedics 的器官护理系统 (OCS) 对飞行中的器官进行持续监测，从而使可靠的连接成为操作的核心。

TransMedics 全球物流副总裁安德烈·科斯塔 (Andre Costa) 表示：“我们运营的每架航班都有可能挽救生命，这使得在关键任务运输过程中能够持续、实时地了解每个器官的状态。” “我们很自豪能够率先实施这一举措。到 2027 年中期，Gogo Galileo 将在我们的整个机队中运行，使 TransMedics 成为第一家也是唯一一家实现这一里程碑的器官移植公司，我们计划在 2028 年将这一能力扩展到我们的欧洲机队。”
Costa 补充道：“我们选择 Gogo Galileo 不仅是因为这些关键任务所需的可靠、高性能连接，也是因为 Gogo 为其客户提供网络安全、系统冗余和主动监控。”
Gogo Galileo 由 Eutelsat OneWeb 的企业级低地球轨道 (LEO) 网络提供支持。
Gogo 首席执行官克里斯·摩尔 (Chris Moore) 表示：“公务航空支持的远不止是高管旅行：它支持社区日常所依赖的关键任务。” “TransMedics 就是一个强有力的例子。当您运输捐赠器官时，连接并不是一种便利；它是使命的一部分。”
TransMedics 选择 Galileo HDX 来支持时间紧迫的器官输送任务的帖子首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, is the contracting activity (W911NF-17-D-0001). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 7, 2017 U.S. AIR FORCE Kelly Aviation Center LP , San Antonio, has been awarded a $1,001,978,024 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for KC-10 engine contractor logistic support. Contractor will provide engine teardown and overhaul, on-wing support/contract field teams, and engine parts and logistics. In addition, the contractor will provide all support required to fulfill this requirement, including but not limited to labor, materials, tools, equipment, parts, and transportation. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity (FA8105-17-D-0002). U.S. NAVY Avian LLC , Lexington Park, Maryland, is being awarded an $11,402,443 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide support for the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division’s Integrated System Evaluation Experimentation and Test Department (AIR-5.1). Services provided will include flight test engineering, programmatic, administrative, design, execution, analysis, evaluation, and reporting of tests and experiments of aircraft, unmanned air systems, weapons and weapons systems. The Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N00421-17-C-0049). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 8, 2017 U.S. NAVY Sierra Nevada Corp. , Rancho, California, is being awarded a $30,995,905 modification to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N00174-09-D-0003) to extend the ordering period and exercise Option Year 6 for the procurement and support of the transmitting set, countermeasures AN/PLT-5, to support explosive ordnance disposal personnel. The AN/PLT-5 is a man-portable system in support of the Joint Service Explosive Ordnance Disposal Counter Radio Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare program. The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technology Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity. Vector Planning and Services Inc. , San Diego, is being awarded a potential $17,910,070 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide cyberspace science, research, engineering, and technology integration. Support includes innovative technology assessment and development; rapid software development and prototyping; enabling capability training; security engineering; and cybersecurity risk management. This is one of four multiple-award contracts. All awardees will have the opportunity to compete for task orders during the ordering period. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Center Pacific, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N66001-17-D-0117). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 9, 2017 U.S. MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY Lockheed Martin Space Systems Co. , Sunnyvale, California, was awarded a $53,052,807 competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for a 36-month period with no options for the Multi-Object Kill Vehicle Technology Risk Reduction (TRR) effort. This contract represents part of the Missile Defense Agency’s technology risk reduction strategy to improve performance and reduce risk for a gimbaled seeker assembly, integrated avionics assembly, component integration and testing, and an advanced seeker. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (HQ0147-17-C-0002). U.S. NAVY ViON Corp. , Herndon, California, is being awarded a $34,790,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide Capacity as a Service support to Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command (Spawar) Headquarters, Spawar System Center Pacific and Spawar System Center Atlantic. The Capacity as a Service acquisition model allows Spawar to more accurately scale, up and down, its information technology (IT) infrastructure to meet evolving mission requirements. Savings are realized through no up-front costs and a “pay as you go” acquisition model, reducing waste usually associated with overbuying of IT equipment to eventually meet an expectation of mission requirement. Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003). body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. The aircraft design was originally developed by Volkswagen China and was transferred to Diamond following a deal between the two companies in February 2024. A subscale prototype of the V.MO first flew in 2022. The full-scale aircraft design was unveiled at the Zhuhai Airshow in November 2024. No official certification plans have been announced. Structure and Powertrain The V.MO seats a pilot and four passengers in a streamlined cabin. The aircraft features a twin-boom connected by fore and aft wings, with eight vertical lift fans distributed along the booms. The aircraft features two pusher propellers, providing propulsion during wing-borne cruise flight. The aircraft features distributed electric propulsion (DEP), with each propeller powered by its own electric motor. This design approach provides high redundancy and reliability by eliminating critical points of failure. title_en: JetBlue Promises An Operating Profit In 2027, But Its Margins Are Getting Worse
title_zh: 捷蓝航空承诺 2027 年实现营业利润，但其利润率正在恶化
summary: JetBlue's CEO says the airline will post an operating profit in 2027, even as Q3 2026 margins worsened and debt nears $9 billion. Here's why the math looks shaky.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空首席执行官表示，尽管 2026 年第三季度利润率恶化且债务接近 90 亿美元，但该航空公司仍将在 2027 年实现营业利润。这就是为什么数学
body_en: JetBlue is obviously in a tough financial spot. The airline hasn’t turned a profit since before the pandemic, and is approaching $9 billion in debt, which is just not sustainable in the long run. It sure seems like a trip into Chapter 11 bankruptcy is in the cards — the CEO has insisted it won’t happen in 2026 , but I think that’s about the only thing that can be promised.
Anyway, JetBlue has just released its Q3 2026 results , and there’s quite a bit of optimism in there… including a claim that JetBlue will turn an operating profit in 2027?!
JetBlue losses widen, but airline claims 2027 will be different

JetBlue has posted a net loss of $257 million in Q3 2026, with an operating loss of $144 million, meaning the operating margin was negative 5.1%. Admittedly it has been a tough year for all carriers, given the increase in jet fuel prices. While airlines have been able to increase fares somewhat, it hasn’t been enough to fully offset the increase in costs.
For context, below are JetBlue’s operating income and margin over the past seven quarters, since the beginning of 2025. That amounts to close to $900 million in operating losses over seven quarters.

While JetBlue’s stock has been in a downward spiral in recent times, given the likely possibility of a Chapter 11 filing , the carrier’s Q3 2026 release are sending the stock up significantly pre-market, despite a slight revenue and earnings per share miss.
What’s the great news from JetBlue? Well, CEO Joanna Geraghty is confident the airline will turn an operating profit in 2027

“I’m very encouraged by the progress we made in the third quarter. Resilient demand and strong yields drove revenue well ahead of our initial expectations, allowing us to recapture more of the increase in fuel costs than we initially expected. That momentum has carried into the fourth quarter, and Fort Lauderdale continues to deliver exceptional results even as we significantly grow capacity.”

“We delivered year-over-year adjusted operating margin improvement in the third quarter and expect further expansion in the fourth quarter even with higher fuel prices. Together with continued JetForward execution, this reinforces our confidence in achieving sustained operating profitability in 2027 and delivering at least $1 EPS and positive free cash flow in 2028.”

Let me emphasize that an operating profit and a net profit are not the same thing. JetBlue is currently paying around $600 million per year in interest expenses. However, an operating profit would of course be major progress. The question is, is this just baseless optimism on the part of JetBlue, or what’s going on?
Help me understand the math on JetBlue’s turnaround?

It’s of course great to claim that the airline will turn an operating profit in 2027, though the math isn’t really mathing for me here. Yes, I think JetBlue is making some generally positive changes, like rolling out first class , and increasingly leaning into its loyalty program , including opening lounges .

However, the carrier’s margins are (understandably) getting worse rather than better, so I don’t really see how anyone can make the claim about profitability in 2027, other than just pure hope and optimism.

Broadly speaking, it feels like many industry executives are basically taking the approach of thinking that jet fuel prices will decrease materially, all while airlines will be able to maintain the fare increases they’ve been able to push through since the start of the war.

I do feel like JetBlue management has lost a bit of credibility when it comes to their claims about JetForward and profitability. In early 2025, the company’s CFO claimed the airline expected to reach a positive operating margin in 2025. Obviously that didn’t happen.

Then in early 2026, the company’s management said it expected a breakeven or positive operating margin for 2026. Obviously that didn’t happen either. Admittedly many issues were due to macro trends beyond the carrier’s control, but that’s also just a reality of the industry.

So I’d view the 2027 operating profit goal as being one based on perfect macro conditions, with airlines able to maintain the same pricing power with much lower fuel prices. This is overly simplistic, but just to put this into perspective
In the first three quarters of 2026, American had revenue of $47 billion, an operating income of $521 million, and an operating margin of 1.1%
In the first three quarters of 2026, JetBlue had revenue of $7.75 billion, an operating income of -$509 million, and an operating margin of -6.6%
body_zh: 捷蓝航空显然陷入了财务困境。自疫情爆发前以来，该航空公司一直没有实现盈利，债务接近 90 亿美元，从长远来看，这是不可持续的。看起来根据美国破产法第 11 章破产的可能性确实存在——首席执行官坚称这种情况在 2026 年不会发生，但我认为这是唯一可以承诺的事情。
不管怎样，捷蓝航空刚刚发布了 2026 年第三季度业绩，其中有相当多的乐观情绪……包括声称捷蓝航空将在 2027 年实现营业利润？！
捷蓝航空亏损扩大，但航空公司声称 2027 年情况将有所不同
捷蓝航空公布 2026 年第三季度净亏损 2.57 亿美元，运营亏损 1.44 亿美元，意味着运营利润率为负 5.1%。诚然，鉴于航空燃油价格的上涨，对于所有航空公司来说，今年都是艰难的一年。虽然航空公司能够稍微提高票价，但这还不足以完全抵消成本的增加。
以下是捷蓝航空自 2025 年初以来过去七个季度的营业收入和利润率。这相当于七个季度的营业亏损接近 9 亿美元。
季度 营业收入 营业利润率 2025 年第一季度 -$1.74 亿 -8.2% 2025 年第二季度 +600 万美元 +0.3% 2025 年第三季度 -1 亿美元 -4.3% 2025 年第四季度 -1 亿美元 -4.5% 2026 年第一季度 -2.24 亿美元 -10.0% 2026 年第二季度 -1.41 亿美元 -5.2% 第三季度2026 年 -1.44 亿美元 -5.1%
尽管捷蓝航空的股​​价近期一直呈螺旋式下跌，但考虑到可能会根据美国破产法第 11 章进行备案，该航空公司发布的 2026 年第三季度财报导致该股在上市前大幅上涨，尽管营收和每股收益略有下降。
捷蓝航空有什么好消息？首席执行官乔安娜·杰拉蒂 (Joanna Geraghty) 有信心该航空公司将在 2027 年实现营业利润
“我对第三季度取得的进展感到非常鼓舞。有弹性的需求和强劲的产量推动收入远远超出我们最初的预期，使我们能够重新获得比最初预期更多的燃料成本增长。这种势头一直延续到第四季度，即使我们大幅增加产能，劳德代尔堡仍继续取得出色的业绩。”
“我们在第三季度实现了同比调整后营业利润率的改善，并预计即使在燃油价格上涨的情况下，第四季度也会进一步扩张。再加上 JetForward 的持续执行，这增强了我们在 2027 年实现持续运营盈利能力并在 2028 年实现至少 1 美元每股收益和正自由现金流的信心。”
让我强调一下，营业利润和净利润不是一回事。捷蓝航空目前每年支付约 6 亿美元的利息费用。然而，营业利润当然是重大进步。问题是，这只是捷蓝航空毫无根据的乐观情绪，还是到底发生了什么？
帮我理解捷蓝航空扭亏为盈的数学原理吗？
声称该航空公司将在 2027 年实现营业利润当然是件好事，尽管这里的数学对我来说并不是真正的数学。是的，我认为捷蓝航空正在做出一些总体上积极的改变，例如推出头等舱，并越来越倾向于其忠诚度计划，包括开设休息室。
然而，该运营商的利润率（可以理解）变得更糟而不是更好，所以我真的不明白除了纯粹的希望和乐观之外，还有什么人可以声称 2027 年的盈利能力。
从广义上讲，感觉许多行业高管基本上都认为航空燃油价格将大幅下降，而航空公司将能够维持自战争开始以来一直推动的票价上涨。
我确实觉得捷蓝航空管理层在谈到 JetForward 和盈利能力时已经失去了一点可信度。 2025 年初，该公司首席财务官声称该航空公司预计将在 2025 年实现正运营利润。显然，这并没有发生。
然后在 2026 年初，该公司管理层表示，预计 2026 年将实现盈亏平衡或正营业利润率。显然，这也没有发生。诚然，许多问题是由于运营商无法控制的宏观趋势造成的，但这也是行业的现实。
因此，我认为 2027 年营业利润目标是基于完美的宏观条件的目标，航空公司能够以低得多的燃油价格保持相同的定价能力。这过于简单化了，但只是为了客观地看待这一点
